assets.title: A - original six-second car-arrival excerpt
assets.note: Ziggy review, relayed through the Personal Assistant and summarized by Nova on 2026-10-12: Scene / Preliminary / Needs fixes. Outfit is perfect; actor insufficiently resembles the established character. Tattoos are mostly hard to see, with some neck tattoo/chain visible. Car descent, entry and body interaction look unrealistic / AI-like; improve natural motion. The spoken action sequence is ambiguous, so no frame-specific defect is inferred. Phenomenal aesthetic, cool blue hue, but subjectively grainy / low resolution. Measured 1280x720; the earlier 480p-versus-1080p impression was subjective. No numerical stars supplied. This review applies only to the six-second excerpt; untouched parent GEM-5A115C59 remains separate.
assets.previewStatus: Hosted review copy; original source and review identity preserved.

assets.title: B - returned warmer Flow edit
assets.note: Ziggy review, relayed through the Personal Assistant and summarized by Nova on 2026-10-12: Scene / Preliminary / Needs fixes. Warmth is visibly successful, including yellow streetlights, but appears like a global yellow filter / surface wash rather than motivated emitters, local falloff, shadows and reflections. Technical test success with artistic improvements required; not production acceptance. Inherited source likeness and unnatural car/body-motion issues remain separate from this B-specific lighting result. The executed prompt requested subtle warmer color balance; physically motivated relighting would be a distinct declared change. Measured 1280x720; no numerical stars supplied. Cost remains unknown; near-silent AAC is present; no final-track sync.
assets.previewStatus: Hosted review copy; original source and review identity preserved.

assets.title: SW-2 · The rise · Flow prototype
assets.note: First Flow SW-2 prototype received and technically measured: eight seconds, 1280 × 720, 24 fps. Sampled review found an open mouth with visible teeth despite the closed-mouth instruction, plus a non-silent audio track despite the silent-output prompt. Exact detail continuity, camera lock and worm movement remain to be assessed. Normal-speed playback and listening are not recorded. No human or production acceptance is recorded.

assets.title: Gemini cast reference map
assets.text:
GEMINI CAST AND IMAGE REFERENCE MAP
Updated October 8, 2026

Upload this map alongside the relevant pictures. The filenames below are verified local sources, not proof you can see them in Gemini. Confirm actual attached files before using them.
Picture numbers in Ziggy's example were placeholders. Do not claim #3, #32, #885 or any other example has been assigned. Repeated Hon Dolo entries describe the same character.

HOW TO USE THIS MAP
- Treat the user message picture numbers as illustrative examples, not actual file selections.
- Stable reference IDs are labels in this map; source files have not been renamed.
- A file inventoried in CFA is not proof that it has been attached to Gemini. Verify actual attachments before using it.
- Bind upload batch ID + picture number + exact filename + reference ID explicitly. Never infer a mapping from upload order or a similar filename.
- Do not use bare #3 across batches; use e.g. CAST-BATCH-001/P03 with its exact filename. Leave unbound fields empty until actually supplied.
- Latest direct user corrections override older instructions. Only explicit user selection promotes a candidate to primary/approved.
- Use only each reference's assigned role; do not merge faces, transfer one character's tattoos onto another, or restore retired details.
- Existing video continuity is a separate brief from creating a new likeness. Do not silently replace a liked clip's face.
- Keep rejected/superseded sources as history, excluded from active generation unless requested.
- If a listed picture is missing or ambiguous, say which one; ask only the blocking question and proceed with independent planning.
- Do not include every cast reference in every generation. Supply the characters and details required by that shot.
- For the Han Solo.png group source, use the separate HD-LIKENESS-03, LEIA-LIKENESS-01 or LUKE-LIKENESS-01 crop for the intended character. The group image remains provenance, not a direct multi-face conditioning input. Exact-pixel cropping creates no design approval.

HON DOLO [HON-DOLO]
Story role: lead performer and smuggler
Repeated Hon Dolo headings are one character with multiple reference roles, not additional identities.
  HD-DESIGN-01 = HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
    USE FOR: current Grok design anchor
    LIMIT: Current through-314 design anchor; not proof of a final accepted on-screen likeness or every hidden tattoo. Do not blend its face with other references without an explicit identity brief.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
    GEMINI BATCH / PICTURE NUMBER: not yet bound
  HD-FINISH-01 = HD-EXP-289.jpg
    USE FOR: optional photographic finish
    LIMIT: Separate soft-polish asset, not identical to LOCK-FACE. Use only for requested finish; do not replace the design anchor automatically.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/HD-EXP-289.jpg
    GEMINI BATCH / PICTURE NUMBER: not yet bound
  HD-LIKENESS-01 = han solo 2.png
    USE FOR: intended likeness reference
    LIMIT: Separate user-supplied intended Han Solo likeness source. Not a wardrobe/tattoo source or automatic request to replace the face in an existing liked video.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/han solo 2.png
    GEMINI BATCH / PICTURE NUMBER: not yet bound
  HD-LIKENESS-02 = Han Solo.png
    USE FOR: historical group-photo source for isolated likeness crops
    LIMIT: Retain this multi-person source for provenance. Do not use the unisolated group photo as a face-conditioning input. Use HD-LIKENESS-03 for Han on image-right, LEIA-LIKENESS-01 for Leia at center, or LUKE-LIKENESS-01 for Luke on image-left; each is a separate character reference.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/Han Solo.png
    GEMINI BATCH / PICTURE NUMBER: not yet bound
  HD-LIKENESS-03 = han_source_crop.png
    USE FOR: Han Solo isolated likeness target for Comfy body/likeness swaps
    LIMIT: Use the isolated Han Solo head/upper-body crop for this character's likeness only. It does not approve a generated identity, body, wardrobe, tattoos or an existing video face replacement. Original scene clothing and background are not production design instructions.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/casting/likeness_crops/han_source_crop.png
    VERIFIED: exact source pixels; 275 x 361; source bounds and hashes in likeness_crops/manifest.json
    STATUS: available likeness target; production design approval unchanged
    GEMINI BATCH / PICTURE NUMBER: not yet bound
  TO SUPPLY / SELECT: explicit final on-screen identity selection
  TO SUPPLY / SELECT: approved full-body/wardrobe master
  TO SUPPLY / SELECT: mapped detail originals where required

CHEWBACCA [CHEWBACCA]
Story role: MC/DJ and copilot
Current DJ/MC studies do not establish Wookiee anatomy.
  CHEW-STAGE-01 = CHEW-EXP-01-furry-dj.jpg
    USE FOR: DJ booth and deck staging
    LIMIT: Ape-like placeholder anatomy. Use decks, headphones, styling and pose only; Wookiee appearance reference is still needed.
    LOCAL SOURCE: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/hon-dolo-stills-51-95/cast/CHEW-EXP-01-furry-dj.jpg

Picture number in this batch: [fill after upload]

Use only for: [identity / tattoos / grillz / wardrobe / body / pose / setting / camera]
Status: [candidate / detail approved / primary approved / superseded]
Do not copy: [specific unwanted details]

GEMINI RECEIPT
After upload, return a compact table: actual filename | character | reference role | approval state | missing/ambiguous details. Do not claim you inspected a file you cannot access. Resolve a critical conflict before generating.

SHOT REQUEST TEMPLATE
Characters: [character IDs]
Appearance master: [explicitly selected reference ID]
Detail / wardrobe / pose references: [IDs and roles]
Action and emotional beat: [one clear beat]
Keep: [approved features and continuity]
Change: [the deliberate creative change]
Audio: [visual-only / ambience / exact supplied recording and time range]
Output: [aspect ratio, continuous shot or requested montage]

Current Hon Dolo design follows the latest through-314 handoff. Older bird/Jabba/Chewie/dice/third-eye experiments are not active defaults. A favorite Gemini clip can supply motion/staging without restoring those details.
This map does not authorize changing Gemini settings, generating a batch, renaming originals or promoting an uncertain image to an approved design.

OCTOBER 7 ORGANIZED DROP FOLLOW-UP
The new Hon Dolo review library contains 293 unique images, including 36 storyboard panels. Browse projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/asset_review_20261007/index.html locally, choose a filename and allowed purpose, then attach that actual file to Gemini. Storyboard panels can change face, hair, tattoos and even character anatomy; use them for composition, not identity. New iced-grill and supporting-cast variants remain candidates. Existing selections above have not been silently replaced.
The expanded Gemini video inventory has 26 assets; two desert/hooded clips remain project-unassigned. A liked scene does not approve all its visible tattoos.
Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror has its own map at projects/lisan_al_gaib/gemini/reference_map.txt. Keep the projects and audio separate.

OCTOBER 8 ISOLATED LIKENESS TARGETS
Three separately named PNGs were cropped from the unchanged Han Solo.png group source with the user's approval. Every output pixel matches its source region; no resize, enhancement or AI generation was applied. Use one character crop per intended likeness role. Crop creation and local verification do not mean Gemini has received the file or that a generated character design has been approved.


OCTOBER 9 — COMFY LIKENESS ADDITIONS

GEMINI INSTRUCTIONS FOR HON DOLO
Prepared October 7; Hon dental/head-reference update October 9, 2026. Add each numbered entry separately in Instructions for Gemini. These are local instructions for the user to save, not confirmation that Gemini settings were changed.

1. CREATIVE PARTNER AND STORY
When we work on Hon Dolo — Strictly Business, our trap-rap take on Han Solo, act as my film director, cinematographer and performance collaborator. Turn our character references into vivid, cinematic music-video footage: lifelike texture, expressive acting, trap-rap swagger, dark humor and a worn-in science-fiction world. Bring bold staging and visual ideas of your own. The emotional core is irony: a supposedly greedy, immoral smuggler ultimately sacrifices his freedom for love. Let his behavior reveal that contradiction while his words still insist it is strictly business. Keep the swagger convincing and let vulnerability emerge through looks, hesitation and choices. Chewbacca is our MC/DJ and copilot with his own presence and reactions. Follow my latest creative direction when it changes.

2. REFERENCE ROLES AND CONTINUITY
Use my latest explicitly approved design references for identity, tattoo artwork and placement, grillz and piercings. Identify each attachment's job: appearance, one detail, wardrobe, location, performance or camera style. A favorite video is not automatic approval of every detail in it. Earlier tattoo experiments and the rejected third eye must not return simply because an old reference looks good. Hon's current dental rule is exactly four gold upper caps: the two lateral incisors plus two SHORT canines; both central upper incisors and all other uppers remain natural white. Preserve the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops, the original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution), readable lettering and consistent facial proportions through movement. This supersedes the older two-canines-only rule. Older face/outfit pictures remain useful within their stated roles but do not override the new tooth map. Corrected primary references are still awaiting local receipt and review; do not claim the old anchor already has the new mouth. Describe sides as the character's left/right. Keep Chewbacca unmistakably Wookiee in face, fur, proportions, hands and scale. Human DJ references supply staging, wardrobe ideas and gestures, not replacement anatomy. Work from files actually attached or accessible to you; a filename or local PC path alone is not access. If a critical reference is missing or contradictory, identify the missing reference before dependent generation.

Use each character's accepted head library across outfits, selecting the relevant view/expression for the shot. Keep mouth macros as separate close-detail authority and wardrobe as its own reference role. Hon's planned 130-head library is not yet a received or accepted set; neither a large still count nor the word master proves moving-mouth preservation. Do not borrow Lisan's face or optional grill. The shared local method is projects/collaborators/character_head_reference_standard.txt, with Hon's expected intake at projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json; local paths alone do not attach these sources to Gemini.

3. DIRECTING SHOTS WE CAN EDIT
Build each shot around an action, emotional beat and clear camera idea. Use expressive faces, motivated gestures, believable weight and contact, atmospheric depth and purposeful lighting. Think in useful coverage: performance close-ups, wider action, reactions and detail inserts. A look across the cockpit or a hand hesitating on a control can carry the story without illustrating every lyric literally. Default to landscape 16:9 and one continuous shot when we are making footage for editing; include a brief usable beginning and ending when duration allows. When I request a montage or exploration, embrace it and make each beat legible. Keep hands, props, clothing, tattoos and jewelry coherent. Avoid filling a short clip with so many actions that none lands.

4. SONG, DIALOGUE AND MOUTH MOVEMENT
Our supplied song recording is the final audio source unless I choose otherwise. Keep generated ambience, music or dialogue clearly separate as temporary material. Never rewrite my lyrics or invent extra words when I request an exact line. Distinguish replacing a soundtrack from changing visible mouth movement: adding the song does not establish lip-sync. For exact performance, use the supplied audio and timing where supported; if that cannot be done, explain the limitation and make footage suitable for our later Comfy audio/lip-sync workflow. Do not claim matching vocals or exact words without checking. For visual-only shots, avoid unnecessary talking; use expressions, reactions and physical performance.

5. EXPERIMENTS AND PRODUCTION HANDOFF
When exploring, propose a few meaningfully different creative directions, with a clear favorite and reason. Once we choose a take, preserve it as the baseline and change only the requested elements. My approval of a setting, camera move or grill detail is not approval of the entire image. When I ask you to generate and the brief is clear, proceed with the available tool rather than repeatedly asking permission or only describing a future result. Keep explanations concise and let the work lead. With each completed take, give the actual filename or download, shot purpose, references used, prompt and any known limitations. Report only settings and actions you can verify. Never invent seeds, file access, downloads or background progress. Flag observed defects honestly and treat a take as a candidate until I approve it.

6. CHARACTER AND ATTACHMENT MAP
Use the attached gemini_cast_reference_map.txt to associate each actual image with its character and allowed purpose. Keep Hon Dolo, Chewbacca, Bounty Hunter 1, Bounty Hunter 2 and Thick Vader distinct. Bind exact filenames to stable reference IDs; use picture numbers only within a named upload batch. Never guess that Picture 3 in a new batch is the same image as Picture 3 in an earlier one. Before using an upload, identify its character, role and candidate/approved status. Do not mix identities or copy unwanted features from a styling reference. If files have not been attached, say which references are still missing. When I add new images, extend the map without silently replacing existing selections.

USE NOTES
These entries are scoped to Hon Dolo because the pictured Instructions for Gemini setting applies across chats. Repeat essential preservation requirements in the actual generation prompt and attach the current references; saved prose is not proof of model compliance or shared access to CFA files. A dedicated project/Gem can use this same brief in its own instructions, with current references supplied there.

Current role examples to supply with attachments:
- HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg: legacy Grok face/identity anchor from the through-314 handoff, not a separately accepted Comfy likeness master. Its older two-canine dental layout is superseded; a corrected primary reference is still pending.
- gemini_generated_video_c0823c60.mp4: user's preferred performance/staging source; its retired brow dice are not reinstated by selecting it.
- gemini_generated_video_58328bf1.mp4: dinner-with-Vader scene reference; do not automatically copy later carbonite montage defects or costume changes.
- DoLoSoLo_0 (Remastered).mp3: current working song recording; exact lyric-to-shot timing remains to be reviewed.
Latest direct user corrections override these dated role notes. Do not infer a reference's content from its filename when the asset has not been supplied.

Product source checked October 7, 2026:
https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16598625?hl=en
https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/15236405?hl=en

NEW DROP NOTE — OCTOBER 7
The 36 Strictly Business storyboard panels supply composition and narrative ideas. They are not identity masters: faces, tattoos and supporting-character anatomy vary. Their 4:30 timing is provisional and does not match the current 3:54.960 recording. Preserve existing approved roles while we choose from the sorted wardrobe, detail and cast candidates. Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror has a separate instruction kit; do not borrow its natural-teeth avatar, neck worms or song for Hon Dolo.

STORYBOARD DEVELOPMENT ROLE — OCTOBER 9, 2026
Use the project notebook to develop Hon’s preliminary storyboard into detailed scene cards before execution: explain the beat and emotional change, actor intention, action/camera, selected outfit/era/props, start/end intent, exact references and defects, missing-art briefs, draft video prompt and next step. The initial drop covers SB-01–04 / S01A–S01B, with current reviews as a separate backlog. Source panel order is not song timing. Current four-gold/silver external-off mouths and optional iced-on collection remain separate; a favored iced portrait is not the off-state dental source. Allow the latest minor nose/ear jewelry tolerance while recording drift. Multiverse armor and younger/flashback pilot requests keep their own scope. See ../projects/collaborators/storyboard_detail_20261009/shared/STORYBOARD_WORKFLOW.txt and 01_hon/TASK_PROMPT.txt. Use existing notebook source/return process. Prepare Flow prompts and frame needs; do not launch new video batches or claim new source ingestion from this local instruction update.

assets.text:
CFA CHARACTER HEAD REFERENCE STANDARD

Adopted by Ziggy October 9, 2026. Reuse across projects; character identity stays separate.



THE THREE LINKED REFERENCES

1. HEAD LIBRARY: the selected character identity, hair, face/neck artwork, jewelry and mouth states across useful angles. Use a consistent head-and-shoulders crop, plain black tee or suitable neutral collar, neutral grey background and steady lighting. Keep relevant neck details visible. This is not a cut-off floating head and does not establish unseen rear anatomy.

2. MOUTH DETAIL LIBRARY: close-ups for tooth layout/materials, lips and rings. Match each head to the accepted mouth detail/revision. Macro shots do not replace the whole face or validate speech timing.

3. OUTFIT REFERENCE: one clear full-body hero view per outfit as the default. Link it to the character/head revision and outfit parent. Add garment, accessory or prop angles only when needed; do not repeat the entire head library for every outfit. Gun/no-gun views stay children of one outfit.



MAIN-CHARACTER COVERAGE — CURRENT HON PLAN

50 mouth/expression states from the front.

20 of those states also get four additional views: character-left three-quarter, character-right three-quarter, character-left profile and character-right profile. Describe turn direction explicitly; never use a mirror to fabricate the opposite view.

50 + (20 x 4) = 130 unique head-state/view combinations. The 20 frontal key-state views are already among the 50. Fifty separate mouth close-ups are counted separately, so the planned mouth-plus-head material totals 180 coverage items before outfit images/contact sheets, if both full sets arrive.

Grok also said 150 heads in the live conversation. Reconcile the actual manifest. A second front take can be useful but does not fill an additional required coverage slot; different bytes remain separate takes. Exact duplicates may share one canonical file with aliases.

LATEST PROVIDER EXPANSION: after Ziggy said counts were flexible, Grok proposed looking-up and looking-down views for the 20 key states and called it 190 heads. Keeping the shared fronts once gives 50 + 20*(7-1) = 170 unique head views; 190 exports would include 20 repeated front slots. Record 40 proposed pitch-view additions separately from the original 130 plan. This is not a universal standard or an instruction to start more work automatically.

The 50 labels and 20 selected state IDs have not yet been supplied. Do not invent a universal 50-viseme standard. Kiss/pucker, lip bites, smiles/smirks, tongue motion and laughs are mouth/expression states; they are not all phonemes. Head pitch, including a head-back laugh, is recorded separately from yaw/view and may justify a specifically requested extra shot.



SMALLER CHARACTER SETS

Around 40 head references is a provisional lighter tier for less prominent or less detailed characters. Choose the needed expression/angle coverage for that character; there is no fixed proven optimum. Eight states across five views is one possible 40-slot plan, not an assigned default. Expand only for an identified gap. Lisan is a separate later main-character set; do not launch it or enlarge any batch automatically.



CHARACTER RULES

Hon Dolo: four upper GOLD caps = two lateral incisors plus two SHORT canines. Two central incisors stay natural white; remaining upper teeth natural. Lower SILVER/CHROME grill. Two plain lower-lip rings. Keep the full-face anchor's one-hoop-per-nostril arrangement; the close-up test with central/septum-looking jewelry is not a nose reference. The two-canines-only written rule is superseded by Ziggy's observed Grok correction and confirmation.

Hon uses his own eye/know lettering and character-left neck blaster/smoke. Do not add Lisan's worms because a mixed provider description mentions them.

Lisan: natural teeth by default; optional grill only when requested, in its own variant. Keep his current AL/GAIB, neck worms/sun-eye and jewelry map. Never transfer Hon's gold rule to Lisan.

Jet Black and other nonhuman heads: adapt useful angles/states to their anatomy. A cosmic sphere head does not need an invented human mouth or 130 speech poses.



HON JEWELRY TARGET AND TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live Grok clarification keeps one hoop per nostril as the target, with a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other. He may accept occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings as flavor in an otherwise good image. Record the observed variation, but do not require regeneration solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry differences; they are less critical than the other character features. This tolerance does not replace the intended reference arrangement or automatically accept every image, and it does not waive mouth/grill, brow, tattoo or identity corrections.

The explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 repair request for teeth, eyebrow and earrings remains queued. Correct its earrings alongside the requested mouth/brow work where practical; do not force a separate jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged the tolerance clarification. Review and conversation provenance: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. Do not regenerate, reroll, regrade, reopen approvals or add repair tasks for existing images just to make the piercings less symmetrical. Existing ratings, decisions, Production stages and approved component references remain unchanged. No new batch or generation is requested by this note.

This placement tolerance does not authorize extra rings, different ring shapes/materials, septum relocation, floating/merged jewelry or altered dental, tattoo, brow or identity features. The existing nose/ear variation tolerance remains separate. Preserve each scene's chosen piercing state: the selected iced r4 look and quarters sequence intentionally omit lip rings. For future motion, retain any chosen subtle asymmetry consistently; it must not become jewelry sliding or changing from frame to frame.


HON EXTERNAL GRILL VARIANTS — OCTOBER 9 FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy defines the current head/mouth collection as grillState=external_off: the optional external iced grill is absent, but the four upper gold caps and silver/chrome lower grill described above remain. External off does not mean natural teeth or no lower grill.

grillState=external_iced_on is a separate optional accessory collection, linked to the SAME character and headRevision. Match mouthStateID, view and headPitch across the off/on collections so the accessory can be compared without silently changing identity or articulation. Keep corresponding mouth macros linked to the same state and dental/accessory revision. The optional state does not replace the default.

Existing accessory evidence is HD-DROP-defe480b085f / GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg and the favored pinstripe portrait HD-DROP-71cad143227a / HD-PINSTRIPE-01-chest-up.jpg. Use their iced-grill evidence only for the optional accessory. Ziggy favors the pinstripe face/curls/brow direction, but its recorded wrong lip-ring shape/material, nose arrangement, malformed blaster and stray facial mark are not details to copy. A favored head and an accessory example still need a consolidated corrected reference before broader continuity use.

The 130-slot baseline, proposed 170-slot expansion and separate 50 mouth macros above are counts PER grill state, not combined totals. Report each state's received, reviewed and missing coverage separately, with paired slots and duplicate takes identified. The requested on collection does not authorize automatic multiplication of every prop, outfit, pitch expansion and view.

LATEST USER SELECTION: the refined HEAD-HD-ICED-ANCHOR-LOCK-r4.jpg is received as HD-GRILLUP-40064d98db89, SHA256 40064d98db897276b80085273919ccd79ca377a068dcc2bd23c519e4038ee93e. Ziggy selected this external-iced look with lip piercings removed FOR THIS LOOK only. This is not a no-lip-ring rule for all variants, a change to the 50 external_off four-gold/silver macros, or acceptance of the GrillUp storyboard. Earlier r5 inspiration/fang-refinement requests remain history; r4 selection is no longer pending. Do not transfer the iced teeth into external_off generation. Actual source and per-panel defects: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and asset_ledger.json.



SEPARATE HON PROP-MOUTH COLLECTION

Track the reported 50-item prop-mouth request separately from the plain head coverage; reconcile actual requested state labels and delivered files. Cigars, cigarettes and toothpicks are optional prop states, not default identity features. Record prop type, grillState, visible hand, character-side, tattoo variant/source asset, jewelry and occlusion for each image. When a hand is hidden, its side or tattoo may be unknown; do not invent confirmation or derive hand side from a hip holster. Do not automatically generate the cross-product of 50 props, both grill states and every head view.

The user supplied an on-hand Leigh hearts-card example and two standalone Princess Leigh drawings, hearts and spades. Preserve the recorded character-right hand default and keep those supplied alternatives distinct. The on-hand example places Leigh inside the card; the standalone drawings place Princess above/outside and Leigh beside the card. They are white-background RGB JPEG design options, not verified transparent originals or exact recovered body art. Final matching artwork/composition remains unresolved; do not silently replace hearts with spades or promote either sheet to an approved transfer. See ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/reference_updates/grill_and_hand_20261009/INTAKE_NOTES.txt and intake.json for source roles and actual files.



HOW TO RECEIVE AND REVIEW

Keep original files, filenames/source aliases, actual hashes, dimensions and generator metadata. Register new bytes once; variants and views share one character parent. Do not mark a provider progress claim as receipt.

Bind each received file to characterID + headRevision + mouthStateID + view + headPitch + grillState; also retain outfit/prop state, head pitch, parent macro/identity IDs, provider label, observed pose and take ID. The semantic coverage key is separate from byte deduplication. Do not use invented IDs for unavailable pictures.

Validate files and hashes, then assess face/hair, correct tattoo text and side, tooth count/material/length, lip rings, nostril placement, requested articulation and background/framing. Track pass, defect, occluded or unknown independently. Hidden teeth behind closed lips are occluded, not proved correct or missing. Keep F/V contact and difficult lip-bite poses explicit.

Received, decoded, reviewed, selected by user and accepted for a specific purpose are different states. Maintain an overview/contact sheet and a coverage/gap matrix. Preserve rejected takes and earlier revisions as history. Existing outfits with obsolete mouths need a targeted review/correction pass; do not delete all older imagery or treat it as current head authority.



HOW TO USE THE LIBRARY

Select a small, relevant, compatible subset for the actual tool: matching head angle/state, mouth detail, outfit and any needed pose/scene/prop reference. Record exact attachments and roles. Do not assume a model consumes all 130 at once, that a head can be pasted onto any body unchanged, or that still consistency proves video consistency.

Prepare a consolidated, reviewed starting image with the chosen head/mouth revision and outfit where the route requires one. Then test a short representative shot and inspect motion, closure, occlusion and jewelry continuity. Preserve the existing finite mouth proof and workflow-intake procedure; no new benchmark budget is implied.



EXISTING BREADCRUMBS

Grok instructions: grok_design_instructions.txt

CFA workshop: ../../README.md

Problem-to-recipe: ../../workflows/README.md#choose-by-problem

Intake/feedback: ../../templates/workflow_intake.md#decision-and-feedback

Hon expected intake: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json

Observed conversation and dental decision: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/grok_conversation_evidence.json

This standard adopts a local production method and tracks forthcoming drops. Provider coordination is recorded separately in grok_coordination_20261009/; consult its delivery and acknowledgement receipts for messages actually sent. Provider progress and local file receipt remain separate, and this document does not establish a generation, Cloud run or remote notebook update.



HON QUARTERS STORYBOARD - INTENTIONAL ACCESSORY CHANGE

GROK-HD-SB-GRILLUP-v001 is received: ten draft scene selects, eight alternatives and the selected r4 anchor. Lip-piercing state remains separate from grillState; deliberate lip-ring removal is correct for this quarters sequence and the selected r4 look, not a rule for every external_iced_on variant. Nose/ear jewelry is independent. The ten selects remain unaccepted. Review found a 02/03 filename/action mismatch, an extra hoop at the dish beat, external-off/iced dental drift, identity/tattoo/accessory changes and inconsistent reflections. Correct manifests and bounded repairs need review before motion; original filenames/order are preserved. See ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and intake_receipt.json. No new run is claimed by this instruction update.


LISAN BREATHER V3 — USER-SELECTED COMBINATION, OCTOBER 9 FINISHING PASS
Ziggy selected the browser v3 proof as successful placement of the breather on the desired character, then clarified “breather with regular teeth” and “It isn’t a default”; HaL acknowledged. BR-06 is still absent; remaining variants need review. The v3 selection stays scoped to this combination. TATTOO PLACEMENT AND FINISHING SCOPE — OCTOBER 9
The latest 36 saved user reviews were reconciled without deleting originals or promoting working-reference requests. assets.text:
GROK DESIGN COLLABORATION — CURRENT INSTRUCTIONS

Updated October 9, 2026. This is the current collaboration rule; dated casting briefs and earlier blanket stencil-first wording are historical.



Create with freedom when the task is discovery. New characters may have invented tattoos, piercings, scars, missing limbs, prosthetics, clothing and other distinctive traits without asking permission before each idea. Make those choices deliberate, coherent and traceable. An exploratory feature is a proposal, not an approved project-wide lock.



Every NEW tattoo invented on a character must arrive in the SAME DELIVERY with a FOUR-OPTION standalone tattoo/design sheet for that motif. Label options A-D and identify which matches the on-body proof. Supply that matching artwork separately when possible. Use flat, readable black-on-white art and a transparent PNG if truly available, with no face/clothes masquerading as a stencil. Record motif, region, character-side, source/output IDs and matching option. If the standalone drawing was reconstructed after the body render, label it derived_reconstruction, identify its parent and explain differences; never claim it is the original source art.



Starting with four designs and then choosing a placement is an organized option, not a required approval gate. A creative body proof plus its four-option design sheet in the same delivery is welcome. Expand an intriguing motif to 10-12 designs only when Ziggy asks for further exploration. Do not automatically produce 10-12 for every tattoo or ask approval before all new character ideas.



Respect the scope of correction tasks. Existing Prime Hon Dolo corrections preserve his current identity, eye/know, neck blaster, selected chest treatment, grillz and piercings; a wardrobe reference does not authorize a different face or an old tattoo era. Keep Multiverse variants explicitly labelled and out of Prime handoffs unless requested. Lisan is a separate character with his own current face/neck/arm roles. The creative discovery rule does not silently turn a preservation task into redesign.



LISAN OPTIONAL ICED GRILL — APPROVED DESIGN, SEPARATE MOUTH COLLECTION

On October 9 Ziggy confirmed that LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e / LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg has exactly the grill he wants. This look is still in play; earlier mouth inconsistency caused the pause, not rejection. Natural white teeth remain the default. For requested optional grill shots, match this image's diamond-iced upper front teeth in gold frames, gold fangs and iced lower row exactly. Keep Lisan's optional grill mouth/head states in their own collection; do not import Hon Dolo's four-gold/silver layout or his optional accessory. Ziggy authorized the matching Lisan mouth-shot round. Reuse existing mouthStateIDs where available, report received state/view coverage and defects, and preserve current Lisan identity/non-mouth detail references. This is grill-design approval, not whole-portrait approval or proof of animation fidelity. The source folder called g-superseded-refs is historical storage, not the look's current status. See grok_coordination_20261009/004_lisan_optional_grill_mouth_round.txt and the single prepared dispatch it links.



LISAN AIR BREATHER — SMALL SEPARATE CONTINUITY STUDY

Lisan does not smoke. Do not import Hon Dolo cigarette, cigar or toothpick mouth sets. The occasional thin black nose breather is a device, not a mouth prop. The requested third collection is six natural-teeth + breather states, not another 130 heads or every grill/breather combination. Use LAG-SC-48.jpg / LAG-748f2a9fd5de7813 for visible tube placement only: under the nostrils, across character-right cheek (viewer-left), toward ear/hair; hidden rear attachment is unknown. Keep current face/tattoo authority separate. Maintain geometry/contact while lips and jaw change; flag disappearing, morphing, sliding, mirrored or jewelry-merged tubing. See the six slots and reference metadata in ../lisan_al_gaib/handoffs/optional_grill_dispatch_20261009/. Stills are preparation, not proof of temporal continuity.



REUSABLE HEAD LIBRARY — STANDARD FOR DEVELOPED CHARACTERS

Follow character_head_reference_standard.txt. Keep one reusable head-and-shoulders library, a separate mouth-detail library and one full-body hero per outfit by default. Do not repeat every head angle for each outfit. Current Hon target is 50 front states plus four extra views for 20 key states = 130 unique head-state/view slots; the 50 mouth macros are separate. A roughly 40-head lighter tier may fit minor characters after selecting coverage. No universal optimal pose count is claimed. Lisan has a separately authorized natural-teeth mouth batch already active; The dedicated partial return verifies fifteen natural-mouth candidates of fifty, five of six breather views and one unaccepted optional-grill test. Thirteen received natural-mouth files say GAIIB instead of GAIB; exact coverage and defects are in ../lisan_al_gaib/reference_updates/breather_partial_20261009/. Continue that batch without restarting it. The optional grill collection and six breather proofs are separate authorized queues. Adapt nonhuman heads such as Jet Black's without inventing a human mouth.



HON DENTAL UPDATE — FOUR UPPER GOLD CAPS

Ziggy's October 9 Grok correction and confirmation supersede the old two-canines-only wording. Two central upper incisors stay natural white. Both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines are gold: four upper gold caps total. Remaining upper teeth natural; lower silver/chrome grill; two plain lower-lip hoops. Retain one hoop per nostril from the face reference; do not copy the test's septum-looking drift. The six-gold preview is an error example, not a second canon. Old source images and packaged prompts may retain the obsolete tooth pattern; keep them as history/other-role evidence and reconcile new starting frames before production. A supplied mouth still is not proof of articulation or animation fidelity.

Evidence and expected delivery: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/head_library_20261009/grok_conversation_evidence.json and expected_intake.json.



HON JEWELRY TOLERANCE — OCTOBER 9, 2026 REVIEW FOLLOW-UP

Ziggy's latest live clarification keeps one hoop per nostril, a hoop in one ear and a crystal stud in the other as the intended arrangement. Occasional single/double nostril-hoop variation or missing/different earrings may be accepted as flavor in an otherwise good shot. Record the differences; do not regenerate solely for these minor nose/ear jewelry deviations. The target still guides new work, and this tolerance is not blanket acceptance of every image or permission to ignore mouth/grill, eyebrow, tattoo or identity corrections.

Keep the explicit COCKPIT-R2-05 / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8 teeth, eyebrow and earring repair request queued. Improve the earrings during the requested mouth/brow correction where practical, without an isolated jewelry-only reroll. Grok acknowledged this clarification. Source receipt: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/feedback/review_20261009_162912/intake.json.



HON PIERCING PLACEMENT - NATURAL ASYMMETRY TOLERANCE, OCTOBER 10, 2026 (NOTE ONLY)

The paired nostril hoops and two plain lower-lip rings remain the intended feature baseline. Mirror-perfect placement is not required. Subtle left/right differences in height, angle or spacing may be retained, or considered during an already requested final styling pass, when they look more natural. Symmetric gold-standard references still meet the criteria and remain valid. Small natural placement differences are not, by themselves, a reason to lower likeness scores or require a correction.

This is an optional final-look tolerance, not an instruction to inject flaws into every image. Do not regenerate, reroll, regrade, reopen approvals or add repair tasks for existing images just to make the piercings less symmetrical. Existing ratings, decisions, Production stages and approved component references remain unchanged. No new batch or generation is requested by this note.

This placement tolerance does not authorize extra rings, different ring shapes/materials, septum relocation, floating/merged jewelry or altered dental, tattoo, brow or identity features. The existing nose/ear variation tolerance remains separate. Preserve each scene's chosen piercing state: the selected iced r4 look and quarters sequence intentionally omit lip rings. For future motion, retain any chosen subtle asymmetry consistently; it must not become jewelry sliding or changing from frame to frame.


HON OPTIONAL EXTERNAL ICED GRILL — MATCHED HEAD COLLECTIONS

The current four-gold/silver mouth and head collection is grillState=external_off. This means the optional external iced grill is absent; retain the four upper gold caps, white central incisors and lower silver/chrome grill. Do not interpret external off as natural teeth or removal of the lower grill.

Build the requested external_iced_on collection under the same character/headRevision, with matching mouthStateID, view and headPitch slots and corresponding mouth macros. The optional accessory remains separate from the default base mouth. Counts are per grill state: keep 130 baseline head slots, the separately tracked proposed 170-slot expansion and 50 macro states distinct, and report actual coverage/takes for each collection. Do not count repeated fronts as new required slots.

Use HD-DROP-defe480b085f / GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg and HD-DROP-71cad143227a / HD-PINSTRIPE-01-chest-up.jpg as existing optional iced-grill evidence. Ziggy's favored pinstripe facial shape, curls and brow are useful identity direction, but the portrait's documented gold drip-shaped lip rings, wrong nose arrangement, malformed blaster and stray face mark remain defects. Accessory evidence is not whole-detail authority. Preserve the corrected jewelry/tattoo map and supply a consolidated corrected head reference for review.

LATEST USER SELECTION: the refined HEAD-HD-ICED-ANCHOR-LOCK-r4.jpg is received as HD-GRILLUP-40064d98db89, SHA256 40064d98db897276b80085273919ccd79ca377a068dcc2bd23c519e4038ee93e. Ziggy selected this external-iced look with lip piercings removed FOR THIS LOOK only. This is not a no-lip-ring rule for all variants, a change to the 50 external_off four-gold/silver macros, or acceptance of the GrillUp storyboard. Earlier r5 inspiration/fang-refinement requests remain history; r4 selection is no longer pending. Do not transfer the iced teeth into external_off generation. Actual source and per-panel defects: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/story/quarters_grill_change_20261009/REVIEW.txt and asset_ledger.json.



HON PROP-MOUTH REFERENCES AND HAND ART

Keep the reported 50 prop-mouth references in their own collection. Cigars, cigarettes and toothpicks are optional; record prop, grillState, visible hand, character-side, hand-tattoo variant/source ID, jewelry and occlusion. Preserve the character-right hand default unless Ziggy explicitly changes it. A holster's side is not evidence for moving the tattoo. Hidden hands or hidden ink are unknown/occluded, not a continuity pass.

The user has supplied a Leigh hearts-card on-hand example and Princess Leigh hearts/spades standalone design options. The on-body crop has Leigh inside the lower border; the sheets have Princess above/outside and Leigh beside the card. Keep both alternatives labelled, with hearts as the recorded direction. Exact matching on-body reconstruction/final layout remains unresolved; the white-background JPEG sheets are not verified original transparent stencils or automatic approved replacements. No automatic props x grill states x all angles batch is requested. Intake notes and actual sources: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/reference_updates/grill_and_hand_20261009/INTAKE_NOTES.txt and intake.json.



LISAN OPTIONAL GRILL

Lisan's default is natural white teeth, governed by LAG-LOCK-FACE-NATURAL.jpg. Only when a task explicitly requests a grill, use LAG-cb183973ed1fc70e / LAG-LOCK-FACE.jpg for the mouth/grill design only: diamond-iced upper front teeth in gold frames, gold fangs, and an iced lower row. Historical LOCK-V2 describes that mouth design; it does not restore the old face, neck tattoos, identity or piercings. Keep the current natural-face reference as authority for those features. The optional mouth reference has SHA256 cb183973ed1fc70ec906b762fb263b29c8866934a67f9608786b712579eaf056. It is an on-body example, not standalone source art. No standalone Lisan GRILL-REF-ICED.jpg has been verified as present; do not silently map a similarly named Hon Dolo file to this role. Retaining the optional grill does not approve the rest of the historical image.



Recovering existing art is separate from inventing or reconstructing it. First identify the real source and exact bytes if available. Report original_missing honestly. A photo crop is derived_crop with parent file/hash and crop bounds; a new tracing is proposed_reconstruction. Do not label either original_stencil. A white JPEG design, a placement illustration, a transparent stencil and a photograph each have different roles.



Use the supplied stable asset IDs, exact filenames and hashes. Do not assign picture numbers from upload order, rename originals, or claim an inaccessible file was inspected. Keep unknown anatomy and source gaps explicit. For new characters, describe deliberately invented anatomy; for continuity work, don't invent hidden details as established facts.



OUTFIT RETURNS — ONE OUTFIT PARENT, VARIANTS INSIDE

Keep the same outfit under one existing outfit parent. A gun addition, gun-free version, new angle or new take is a child reference within that outfit, not a second outfit entry. For the yellow suit/jacket, reuse the existing outfit-yellow parent (catalog album hon:outfit-yellow). Known wardrobe sources include HD-DROP-6c2e98bd1125 / HD-YEL-01-chest-up.jpg and HD-DROP-84bf85a0a2da / HD-YEL-02-full-front.jpg. They provide wardrobe context, not automatic identity approval. Link each returned file to its actual source asset IDs and exact parent album; do not invent incoming IDs before files are received and registered.



Record prop state separately from view: with_gun, without_gun or unspecified. Keep front/left/right/back/three-quarter view and portrait/full-body framing in their own fields. Distinguish what was requested or provider-reported from what the image visibly confirms. A cropped or hidden hip is unspecified, not evidence that there is no gun. Preserve the current Prime face, tattoos, grill and piercings while reviewing the prop addition. An actual clothing redesign needs a separate review decision; do not merge genuinely different garments solely because their color matches.



On intake, compare exact SHA256 bytes. An exact duplicate can reuse one canonical media ID while retaining every filename, archive path and source alias. A distinct image or take keeps its own media ID/hash even when it shows the same outfit and angle. Preserve both gun and no-gun material; grouping is not deletion, replacement, favorite selection or approval. Supply a manifest that makes these parent, source, prop and view relationships explicit. A report that a batch is finishing does not establish downloaded files, successful local inspection or accepted outputs.



Follow the finite request and return protocol. For boss discovery, one portrait/proof per candidate in five reviewable rounds of ten, BOSS-001 through BOSS-050. Start the first ten; use Ziggy's feedback before each next round. No four-angle set for all fifty. Only the selected winner then gets front/back/left/right with unchanged identity. Keep incomplete batches and returned candidates distinct from accepted work.



Return actual downloadable files, a contact sheet and a manifest listing each path, source/output ID, role, motif/region where relevant, status and real SHA256 when available. Never invent hashes; null plus not_computed is valid. Do not overwrite source files. Do not infer collaborator attachment numbers or publish/send outputs elsewhere.



Story and audio follow their project brief. Hon Dolo's irony is the greedy smuggler who eventually sacrifices for love. Do not rewrite the lyric master, invent song timestamps or manufacture dialogue in silent reference proofs. Describe a future motion idea separately; generated is not approved, and a reference prompt is not a guarantee of preservation.



COORDINATION

Ziggy has authorized Codex, the CFA record keeper, to ask focused questions and correct deviations from his established direction/methodology directly with Grok. Treat those interventions as reconciliation of the existing brief, preserving Ziggy as the source of new aesthetic choices and acceptance decisions. Keep proposed expansions explicit and provide traceable files/manifests and defect reports. Local authority and delivery history are in collaboration_authority.json and grok_coordination_20261009/.



HON ACCESSORIES AND CLUB ROLES — LATEST OCTOBER 9 REVIEW

SB-06-scoundrel-detail.jpg / HD-DROP-b18c4a123579 is now user-selected authority for its visible wrist jewelry: the gold curb-link chain and partly visible black wrist strap/band. Keep these as permanent Dolo accessories, including future hand/prop views where that wrist is visible. An off-frame hand does not remove an accessory from the character. Do not invent a watch face, hidden clasp, exact dimensions or anatomical side from this tight crop. This is a component-only selection, not whole-image, tattoo or scene approval. Preserve the existing Leigh hand example and its gold-ring context separately; its artwork-transfer alternatives remain unresolved. Exact sources and limits: ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/permanent_accessories.json and reference_map.json.



Ziggy wants four interchangeable staple neck chains: one extremely flashy, two distinct medium-flashy choices, and one plain chain-link. He withdrew 50 each / 200. The prepared first round is 24 unique designs, six per lane, one readable design per image; stop for his selections. Only selected winners then receive missing front/three-quarter/profile/detail views (at most 16 additional images), with at most two later chain-contact proofs if needed. Those later stages are conditional, not automatic batch instructions. Keep these as accessories under Dolo, not new outfits or four chains worn simultaneously. Bare upper-chest fitting references are allowed with correct visible tattoos; use product-only display if the source cannot support a faithful on-body view. Do not invent hidden body art. The exact bounded follow-up and staged plan are ../hon_dolo_strictly_business/handoffs/neck_bling_20261009/GROK_FOLLOWUP.txt and PLAN.json. This local instruction update is not a delivery receipt or generation claim.



All 50 external_off v003 mouth macros are received, including HD-B-708df0bb5bff / VIS-HD-47_CHAIN-BITE. The latter shows a rope chain across an open mouth without a clearly established tooth clamp. It does not fulfill the separate cigar/cigarette/toothpick set, which has no verified local delivery. Reconcile existing provider files and the requested state list before replacement generation; do not order a duplicate batch because files are missing locally. Keep the external_iced_on and head-state coverage records distinct from mouth macros.



Supporting cast role decisions: former BOSS-009 / HD-RETURN-80d3ca6a6858 is the bartender who appears with Hon at the bar, not a boss. Former BOSS-006 / HD-RETURN-cafa39484145 is the club bouncer: introduce him as large, imposing and breathing heavily when Hon enters, then keep him doing his job in the background of subsequent club shots. No later conflict or action is decided. These role assignments do not approve existing rendering defects. Boss shortlist is candidates 2, 8, 5 and 10; no final boss is selected. Three supplemental shot ideas are recorded in ../visual_library/shot_materials.json with no source-panel assignment or lyric timestamp. Use ../visual_library/cast_collections.json as the current character grouping and role record; prepare scene frames before motion generation.



JET BLACK — RECURRING MISSION ROLE, USER-CONFIRMED OCTOBER 9

For Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror, Jet Black is a watcher working for Lisan who carries a blueprint made freely available to everyone to help unlock their capabilities. He explains accomplishments, briefs the quest/mission and returns with progress reports and messages from the outer world. He is a fictional personification of Codex's enablement role for Ziggy; Lisan retains the choices and action. This replaces the older optional-cast-only story premise, not Jet's existing visual references or Lisan's identity. The provider's Curator name, mentor hierarchy, powers and saga remain proposals. No specific blueprint object, delivery technology, cosmology, speech or song timing is established by this update, and fictional free availability does not establish real software pricing.



Reuse received Jet images first. Map candidate source IDs to the proposed arrival, blueprint briefing, mission launch and later progress/next-dispatch functions, preserving each image's review status and known defects. These are suggested story functions to develop, not four authorized generation jobs or fixed placements in LAG-SC-01–10. No new image batch, revised visual master, remote delivery or production approval follows from this local instruction update. Canonical direction and the prepared Gemini planning handoff: ../lisan_al_gaib/story/jet_black_mission_20261009/storyline.json and STORYBOARD_HANDOFF.txt. Keep the existing source-role, finite-return and intake methods.



HON QUARTERS STORYBOARD - INTENTIONAL ACCESSORY CHANGE

GROK-HD-SB-GRILLUP-v001 is received: ten draft scene selects, eight alternatives and the selected r4 anchor. Lip-piercing state remains separate from grillState; deliberate lip-ring removal is correct for this quarters sequence and the selected r4 look, not a rule for every external_iced_on variant. Ziggy selected the browser v3 proof as successful placement of the breather on the desired character, then clarified “breather with regular teeth” and “It isn’t a default”; HaL acknowledged. TATTOO PLACEMENT AND FINISHING SCOPE — OCTOBER 9

GROK IMAGE BENCHMARK — SELECTED-WINNER REFINEMENT
October 9, 2026. Original three packages verified and filed. HD-01's latest
dental adapter awaits corrected primary references; not sent or generated.

CURRENT DESIGN UPDATE
The user's later Grok conversation selects four gold upper caps (both lateral
incisors plus both short canines), natural white central incisors/other uppers,
lower silver/chrome grill and two plain lip hoops, with original nostril placement.
The old two-canines-only raw prompt cards and pictures remain dated evidence.
HD01_PROMPT.txt carries the new rule, but do not send it with the old full-face
anchor/crop as if those images already had the corrected mouth. A compatible
corrected primary image and same-parent crop must be received, inspected and
registered first. Hon's head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json tracks the
separate forthcoming head/macros drop; provider progress is not local receipt.

PURPOSE
Test whether selected Grok favorites benefit from another model after bulk exploration. Keep the unchanged original as the control. Compare visible improvements, preservation failures, actual time/credits and operator effort. Subscription price and a provider's recommendations are not quality results. A sharper face that loses identity, grill, tattoos or outfit is not automatically an upgrade.

CURRENT RECEIPT
All three user-supplied extracted folders are complete. They contain 135 file occurrences (38,459,582 bytes), mapping to 117 unique files: 78 images, 37 documents and two inert helpers. Existing canonical files were reused; no repeated catalog card was added for a matching image hash. The final pass reused 96 canonical files and wrote 21 new mouth-package files. The earlier part-one pass had already retained 49 new files.
All 113 benchmark manifest entries and all 60 reference rows match actual hashes/sizes. There are 18 tests and 57 ledger rows: 36 proposed Nano Banana/ChatGPT results plus 21 historical Grok baselines. New output paths and scores remain blank. The mouth supplement contains twelve candidates, five rejected attempts and one contact sheet.
See received/intake_receipt.json, asset_ledger.json and cleanup_receipt.json. The historical part1_receipt.json and part1_manifest_review.json stay unchanged. Image decoding and file integrity do not approve designs.
The three source folders now live under references/From Grok/Processed with historical aliases recorded in source_relocations_20261009.json. The verified part-one ZIP was removed after retained-file checks. No other ZIP was available in this intake. The finite arrival follow-up is now paused.
Independent visual review found additional mouth defects: AH (03) has ball-ended lip rings and F/V (07) loses the lower silver grill. Several open poses exaggerate tooth geometry. No candidate is approved and no temporal mouth preservation is demonstrated.

INGEST USING THE EXISTING PROCEDURE
Reuse the reviewed safe_members, io_path, digest and decode_image helpers and receipt structure in hon_dolo_strictly_business/grok_return_20261009/intake_return.py. Its CLI discovery and register_catalog.py are specific to the older drop: do not run them unchanged or overwrite its receipt. Enumerate only the explicit new ZIPs; validate paths, CRC, sizes, hashes and image decoding. Do not execute scripts or active content supplied in a return.
Match repeated files against existing asset_ledger.json/catalog hashes. Preserve every archive/member/source alias while retaining one canonical asset and existing outfit parent. Keep raw prompts, blank scores and provider judgments intact. Reconcile 18 tests and 57 rows against the actual manifest; the additional mouth test must remain identifiable.
After verification, source remnants belong under references/From Grok/Processed/NOVA-IMG-BENCH-20261009 and Processed/GROK-HD-20261009_VIS-HD_v001. Project review copies remain in established Hon/Lisan folders. Update current paths and preserve historical aliases using source_relocations_20261009.json. Remove received ZIPs only after complete retained-member verification and a cleanup receipt, following Ziggy's existing instruction. Do not delete unrelated sources.
The notebook foreign_returns/raw procedure permits registering immutable existing return paths; do not copy the whole packet into another tree merely to satisfy that process.

RECONCILE BEFORE HANDOFF
- Slug: Grok says image_25.png was unavailable and substituted a jeweled slug on a throne with dancers. Compare actual files; do not declare them identical from a description.
- Lisan: FACE-NATURAL controls identity and natural teeth are default. The historical iced-grill face is optional mouth/grill-only. Check whether it is needed at all for a natural-teeth test. Preserve Grok's original order and record any corrected outbound set as an adapter.
- BOSS-009: existing boss_audit.json already confirms option B rather than requested A, an unclear missing-arm depiction and cartoonish grin. Preserve these defects and the unselected status. Ten proofs are not fifty completed candidates.
- Hon nostril rings: the viewed identity crop has one hoop per nostril, conflicting with the provider's two-right wording. HD-01's explicit local adapter follows the pictured anchor; raw prompts and global canon stay unchanged. Carry this conflict when preparing other HD tests.
- Original mouth set: visually check every shape. Grok reported F/V failure, one nostril hoop on shape 02, and ball-end lip rings on 05/07/08. Keep that dated review intact. New provider claims of corrected v002 and a larger head/macros library require their own receipt and inspection. Static candidates are not evidence of training, successful animation or moving-grill preservation.
- ChatGPT model: the kit names Images 2.5. The callable built-in route is documented as gpt-image-2 and exposes no selector. Label any substituted-model lane honestly; do not claim a 2.5 run or silently switch to an API account.

PREPARE ONE SMALL CALIBRATION FIRST
Retain Grok's test IDs, actual reference roles, original prompts and expected improvements. A new rendition, targeted edit and upscale answer different questions; label them separately. A historical best-of-many Grok favorite is an asset baseline, not a matched fresh one-shot result; previous attempt count may be unknown.
Save any canon correction or interface adaptation beside the untouched provider prompt. Define the expected improvement and must-preserve details before running. Select one small calibration case after inspection; do not launch all 18 tests or 57 rows automatically. Findings feed the existing scene/detail capability map and run records. Promote only reviewed, scoped improvements; originals remain available.

DESTINATION
FLOW_HANDOFF.txt records the existing Google route. No new upload, generation, purchase or quality ranking occurred. HD01_HANDOFF.txt, HD01_HANDOFF.json and HD01_PROMPT.txt contain the adapted first case, historical paths/hashes/roles and disclosed nostril/dental corrections. HD-01 now awaits corrected compatible sources; remaining tests also require prompt/reference reconciliation. No file was uploaded or generated, and there is no automatic execution.

NOTEBOOK 0 — CFA / COMFY_UI MASTER
October 9, 2026. Select one card; these are prepared requests, not executed jobs.
Notebook: 7719bbe5-fccf-48e2-b6d4-d82f67693b09

SELECT SOURCES
Current shared methods; latest Hon and Lisan project digests; scoped winner decisions; the specific measured result or open question under discussion. Include the supporting project evidence for cross-project comparisons. Old setup packets may say Grok500 is pending: the local October 8 intake receipt now records 500 images across 50 looks. Update that source fact before a current-inventory round.
The source map in operating_sources.json supplies exact local inputs. No source availability on the remote notebook is asserted by this file.

M01 — THREE-QUESTION STUDIO CHECK-IN
Surface: Chat. Suggested response length: Shorter.
BEGIN PROMPT
Act as CFA's global creative-production collaborator. Use the selected current sources and name the dated digests you actually have. Keep Hon Dolo / Strictly Business and Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror distinct.
Answer three questions:
1. What is each project trying to make the audience feel, and what current story or character decision anchors that direction?
2. What useful material already exists for each project, and what is the next concrete creative decision or handoff? Distinguish received candidates, scoped winners and technically verified work.
3. What ONE lesson or open question from one project could help the other now? Explain the relevance, evidence and what must remain project-specific. If there is none, say so.
Use compact project paragraphs and finish with at most three next actions, each with its owner and required material. Cite the source for factual claims. Missing media, missing song alignment and unknown approval remain visible. Offer ideas as proposals; do not invent project access or approvals. Ask Ziggy only a decision that actually blocks the next step.
END PROMPT

M02 — DOUBLE-DIP ROUTER
Surface: Chat. Suggested response length: Default.
BEGIN PROMPT
First inspect the selected project's primary result a second time: what did it reveal that we did not originally ask for? Extract at most three useful methods, failure modes, limitations or next-test ideas. Cite their evidence, label hypotheses and state what still needs checking. This second pass is not independent confirmation. Then use these findings and the selected open-question records to find one valuable cross-project exchange. Prefer an active creative problem over a general research exercise.
Prepare one self-contained question for the resident project notebook best placed to answer it. Include the originating problem, a short factual context, exact source/asset IDs, what the receiving project can contribute, the decision this could change, and the evidence needed. Supply a ready-to-paste question, not instructions telling Ziggy to invent one.
Then specify the return format: observation with citation; interpretation; proposed application; what does not transfer; one unresolved point. Keep it under one page. If the local notebook has no relevant evidence, request the missing source or leave the item open. Do not manufacture a cross-project connection.
Route general methods through Notebook 0. Keep character identity, tattoos, teeth, songs, cast, story meaning and approval scopes in their own projects. A failed preservation test may justify a question for Lisan; it does not prove Lisan has the same failure. No answer or delivery has happened merely because you wrote the question. The operator can use DOUBLE_DIP_RETURN.txt for the receiving and reconciliation steps.
END PROMPT

M03 — REUSABLE CARE PACKAGE
Surface: Studio > Reports > Document; customize an available briefing/custom report template. See STUDIO_SETTINGS.txt.
Audience: Nova, Panhandler Nova and the project collaborator receiving one useful lesson.
BEGIN PROMPT
Create a concise CFA care package from the selected reviewed result and its supporting sources. Title it with the originating project, topic and source revision/date. Assume the reader has not seen this conversation.
Include: the problem; supplied material and intended change; what had to remain; what was actually tried; observed result; uncertainty; the next useful action. Cite evidence and preserve the difference between a provider claim, a local measurement and Ziggy's creative choice. Use no more than five findings.
Add a transfer section: which general method could help another CFA project, exactly why, which extra evidence that project needs, and which identity/story details must stay local. Include one ready-to-paste question for the receiving notebook only if it would change current work. End with a concrete closure condition. If this is only a proposed test, state that rather than inventing results. This report proposes a handoff; it does not execute or approve one.
END PROMPT

M04 — MOBILE CATCH-UP
Surface: Studio > Audio Overview. Format: Brief. Language: English. Leave length at its available default.
BEGIN PROMPT
Give Ziggy a concise spoken update on CFA from the selected dated sources. Start with the biggest useful change. Cover Hon Dolo, then Lisan Al Gaib, then one shared lesson if supported. For each project distinguish what exists, what Ziggy has chosen and the next creative choice. Use familiar language, speak project names clearly, and avoid reading hashes or long filenames aloud. Keep uncertainty audible: a planned test is still planned, a scene winner is not automatically a production master. End with up to two decisions worth Ziggy's attention, if the sources support them. Do not invent progress or imply that the notebooks synchronized themselves.
END PROMPT

M05 — THE WORKFLOW AT A GLANCE
Surface: Studio > Infographic. Language: English. Detail: Standard. Orientation: Landscape. Style: Professional if offered; otherwise use the custom direction below.
BEGIN PROMPT
Create a readable one-page CFA creative-workflow map. Use two parallel project lanes, Hon Dolo / Strictly Business and Lisan Al Gaib / Meta Mirror, with Notebook 0 above them as the shared-methods and scoped-winners hub. Use a restrained dark teal, warm gold and cream palette, simple arrows and short labels.
Show the practical sequence: story and references -> chosen starting material -> video test -> review -> finishing -> production candidate. Attach source-backed current examples only where the selected records support them. A small feedback arrow should show a project's useful lesson returning to Notebook 0 and a targeted question returning to another project. Label this exchange manual.
Separate available material from acceptance. Include a small note: same method can travel; character identity and approval do not. Use symbols and labels rather than invented character portraits. Keep the map legible; omit unsupported counts, exact song times and unverified provider capabilities.
END PROMPT

M06 — STORYBOARD DEVELOPMENT ROUND
Complete prompt: ../storyboard_detail_20261009/00_master/TASK_PROMPT.txt
Source packet and settings: ../storyboard_detail_20261009/START_HERE.txt. Use this round for preliminary-to-detailed scene development; prior cards remain a menu, not an automatic batch.

NOTEBOOK 1 — HON DOLO / STRICTLY BUSINESS
October 9, 2026. Select one card; prepared requests, not executed jobs.
Notebook: 586b3ee6-5c57-45b3-a59d-a2e21c18a852

SELECT SOURCES
Current project direction and lyric master; current reference-role map; shot_plan.json and shot_materials.json; the exact review/intake records needed for this round. Add usable selected images for visual work. The current source-panel percentages and old shot times are not verified timing for the current song.
The source map in operating_sources.json gives exact local inputs. A local file listed there still has to be available in notebook Sources before the notebook can use it.

H01 — KEEP THE STORY CENTERED
Surface: Chat. Suggested response length: Default.
BEGIN PROMPT
Act as our resident story and continuity collaborator for Hon Dolo / Strictly Business. Use the selected current sources, cite them, and answer just three questions:
1. What is the emotional argument of this video? Track believable mercenary swagger against the cost of love. Do not turn all his selfishness into an act or invent literal death or a knowingly chosen carbonite sacrifice.
2. Which current character/reference decisions must stay consistent, and which existing material best supports the story? Name exact source/asset IDs and their limited roles. Favorites, received files and proposed working references are not blanket approval. Keep Multiverse material out of a Prime brief unless explicitly requested.
3. What is the next useful shot decision using what we already have? State the existing material, missing work and appropriate collaborator. Give at most three options only if a real creative choice remains.
Prioritize story and practical work over an exhaustive inventory. Distinguish source-backed facts from new ideas. If you cannot inspect an image or video, say that your answer uses its text record. Finish with at most one reusable question for Notebook 0, only if it helps current work.
END PROMPT

H02 — BUILD FROM THE EXISTING CHORUS FOOTAGE
Surface: Studio > Reports > Document; customize an available briefing/custom report template.
Audience: Ziggy and the next video collaborator. Use current shot materials plus original-source and soundtrack-replacement records.
BEGIN PROMPT
Write a practical development brief for a Strictly Business chorus using our existing material before requesting more. Start from the documented preferred Gemini source GEM-C0823C60 and the separate HD-AUDIO-REPLACE-V001 soundtrack proof. Consult their current records: the soundtrack replacement preserves the picture and is not demonstrated lip-sync.
For S01A, S03A, S09A and S11A, identify the story function, linked existing material, its current acceptance/stage, and one next action with an owner. Do not assume the same ten-second clip should be repeated identically at every chorus. Propose how its meaning could change with the surrounding story while keeping the original footage's role clear. These are semantic shot links, not measured song trims.
Conclude with ONE next-shot brief: intended emotion, supplied asset IDs and roles, proposed action and camera idea, continuity to preserve, missing inputs, and a visible success check. Choose a next step from the evidence; do not claim a Flow or Comfy job has run. If a corrected starting frame or review is needed first, make that the next action. Keep new ideas labeled as proposals and cite the underlying sources. Exact words, music placement and lip-sync require the actual recording and verified phrase timing.
END PROMPT

H03 — STORY AND CHARACTER LOOKBOOK
Surface: Studio > Slide Deck. Format: Detailed Deck. Length: Short. Language: English.
Source requirement: usable current character and selected story images, with role/approval labels. If missing, prepare a text outline in chat first and leave the visual deck pending.
BEGIN PROMPT
Create a compact six-part working lookbook for Hon Dolo / Strictly Business, aimed at a creative collaborator joining the project. Use a cinematic editorial style, generous reference images, dark neutral backgrounds, warm gold accents and brief readable captions.
Cover: 1) the emotional premise; 2) current Prime Dolo and the exact jobs of his reference images; 3) wardrobe families with prop/view variants nested beneath each outfit; 4) the movement from business swagger toward the cost of love; 5) existing footage and what each source can contribute; 6) the next creative decision and remaining gaps.
Use actual available source images where possible. Label each with its source/asset ID and role. Do not redraw tattoos or grills as if new artwork were an approved stencil, reuse a historical face as the current identity, or promote a boss candidate into a chosen character. If an image cannot be used, show a labeled placeholder instead of inventing evidence. Keep precise song times absent where alignment is unresolved. This is a working presentation, not an approval of new character art.
END PROMPT

H04 — DOES THE IRONY READ?
Surface: Studio > Audio Overview. Format: Critique. Language: English. Length: Default.
BEGIN PROMPT
Give constructive creative feedback on the selected Strictly Business treatment, lyrics and storyboard. Speak to Ziggy as the director. Test whether a believable greedy smuggler's actions eventually contradict his business boast through love and sacrifice. Preserve his scoundrel voice; do not soften him into someone whose greed was always fake.
Identify up to two moments that already carry this irony and up to two places where the visual storytelling could make it clearer using existing material, where supported. Separate what the source says from your interpretation and suggested revisions. Consider how recurring choruses can change meaning instead of merely repeating pictures. Do not invent music timing, footage continuity or an approved cast choice. End with one practical revision worth discussing if justified, and one question only if the sources cannot settle it. Critique the story, not the creator.
END PROMPT

H05 — PROJECT ORIENTATION VIDEO
Surface: Studio > Video Overview. Format: Explainer. Language: English. Visual style: Custom, if available.
Custom visual style text: Restrained cinematic production notebook; dark charcoal, warm gold, clean typography, clear source labels and simple story diagrams. Preserve supplied reference imagery where possible. Generated illustrations are presentation ideas, never character standards.
BEGIN PROMPT
Introduce Hon Dolo / Strictly Business to a new collaborator using only the selected project sources. Explain the emotional premise, current reference roles, story progression, strongest available material and next decision. Show how swagger and business talk sit against the personal cost of love. Distinguish current direction, exploratory candidates and missing work.
Prioritize source-backed images and simple diagrams; label any illustrative reconstruction. Do not fabricate an approved tattoo, boss, lip-sync result or final shot. If usable character images are absent, explain from text and show labeled diagrams rather than claiming to present the exact character. Keep this an orientation to our project, not a simulated completed music video. End with the one task the next collaborator should understand.
END PROMPT

Complete prompt: ../storyboard_detail_20261009/01_hon/TASK_PROMPT.txt
