assets.text:
HON DOLO BOSS DISCOVERY — 50 CANDIDATES, FIVE ROUNDS OF TEN
Current request: GROK-BOSS-DISCOVERY-20261008. Prepared locally; not sent or generated.

Grok, we are discovering Dolo's boss. The hippo, gecko-frog and original slug are three earlier directions, not three locked cast members. Use the actual attached files and roles in ASSET_MAP.json. We like the hippo's studio/boss premise but want a less cartoon-like, cinematic creature. The gecko-frog is too cartoon-like in its current eyes/grin. The slug/dais reference supplies another silhouette and opulent staging direction. These are artistic starting points, not a requirement to merge all three.

Explore coherent original creatures with convincing textures, restrained expressions, costume weight and a clear powerful business-boss presence. You may invent tattoos, piercings, missing limbs, prosthetics and other character features when they improve the concept. For every new tattoo, deliver its FOUR-OPTION standalone design sheet in the SAME BATCH, name the matching option, and label any after-the-fact reconstruction honestly. No permission-first tattoo gate. Expand a chosen motif to 10-12 only when Ziggy asks.

START WITH BOSS-001 THROUGH BOSS-010 ONLY.
Each is one readable portrait or three-quarter character proof, not a four-view set. Keep framing/lighting useful for comparison while varying silhouette, anatomy, skin, attitude and costume. Use the ten as a diverse first exploration rather than minor recolors. Return the individual images, a clearly labelled ten-image contact sheet and the manifest. Pause for Ziggy's feedback before BOSS-011..020, then 021..030, 031..040 and 041..050. Keep numbers stable across revisions; use _v002 rather than recycling an ID for a different character.

After Ziggy picks the winning ID, make four consistent views: front, back, character-left and character-right. Use the SAME identity and body, not four redesigns. Only then build the first meeting with pinstripe Hon Dolo; SC-BOSS-001 is on hold until that choice. A later Flow test starts from a selected coherent still. No automatic animations, full rosters of turnarounds or dialogue.

Gemini's refusal of all three earlier directions is user-reported; we have not independently observed the attempts or their reasons. This brief evaluates new designs artistically. It neither promises another service will accept them nor asks you to defeat its restrictions.

RETURN
GROK-BOSS-DISCOVERY-20261008_round01_return_v001.zip
  GROK-BOSS-DISCOVERY-20261008_round01_return_v001/
    RETURN_MANIFEST.json
    QA_NOTES.txt
    contact/BOSS-001-010_contact.jpg
    characters/BOSS-001_v001.png ... BOSS-010_v001.png
    tattoo_designs/BOSS-001/<motif>_options-A-D.png [only if that proof invents a tattoo]
    tattoo_designs/BOSS-001/<motif>_matching-option-A.png [actual matching option; letter may differ]

List every actual file, stable candidate ID, exact input ID/filename/hash, new output filename/hash, intentional features, tattoo region/side, matching design option and status. Hashes must come from file bytes; unknown is null/not_computed. A crop is not original stencil art. No placeholder empty images. Keep all candidates needs_user_review. The selected winner and follow-up four-view filenames remain null until a real selection is made.

The early debt/boss sequence supports Strictly Business: the greedy smuggler ultimately sacrifices for love. Do not alter the song master, invent exact lyric timing or add spoken dialogue to these reference images.

Please incorporate this in your planning and continuity checks; this digest does not start another batch or approve the pending iced anchor.

HD-COCKPIT-R2-01.jpg / HD-DROP-14f8eb9979b5: keep the pilot/cockpit idea; fix the blurred/funny grill and neck tattoo. Ziggy allows attractive ship-design variation. His "almost tempted" comment is not a final waiver of the neck correction.
HD-COCKPIT-R2-03.jpg / HD-DROP-1225728294b2: correct the protruding gold tooth and follow the current head standard. He marked detailed design and wants a later Gemini lightspeed shot: pull an overhead lever, ship surges, pilot recoils into the seat. Still correction first; no exact song timing assigned.
HD-COCKPIT-R2-05.jpg / HD-DROP-8ef3180997c8: Grok correction requested for teeth/smile, eyebrow and nonstandard earrings.
These defects reinforce scoped head/mouth checks. Keep the existing external-off four-gold work unchanged and the optional iced-on collection separate.

HD-ARMOR-SWAP-01, 02, 03 and 04 are KEEP as MULTIVERSE, not Prime references. On 03, the user wants the gun on his right instead of left; apply that only to this reviewed image, not a global holster/hand-tattoo side change.
HD-ARMOR-SWAP-04.jpg / HD-DROP-1c375c9d2ea9: he wants futuristic headphone accessory images for this outfit. Queue this scoped accessory idea.
HD-COCKPIT-R2-04.jpg / HD-DROP-104b30b1f4b7: KEEP as a younger-years/flashback pilot with fewer tattoos/earlier teeth. He wants several switch/control/piloting shots later with Grok/Gemini. DO NOT USE FOR NEW HANDOFFS

assets.title: Flow first character experiment
assets.text:
HON DOLO — FIRST FLOW STILL PRESERVATION PROOF
Prepared October 8, 2026. Experiment ID: FLOW-HD-STILL-001.
State: planned; user is still sorting. No upload, model invocation or approved shot is claimed.

PURPOSE
Establish whether Flow keeps the current Hon Dolo face and visible details from one reference before introducing another outfit, character, pose or motion. This still-first sequence takes priority over the earlier proposed first-video test in project_brief.txt. That video prompt remains a later candidate.

SINGLE PLANNED INPUT
Reference ID: HD-DESIGN-01
Asset ID: HD-DROP-ef5d59a6402e
Exact filename: HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
Repository source: docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/references/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/hon-dolo-lock-turnaround-outfits/HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
SHA256: ef5d59a6402eaff568e30bb6a4432b14b90c692ea6758a761c7702c44d457978
Role: current visible Grok design/face reference; no new final production identity approval.
Planned package home: Characters/Hon Dolo. This is organizational intent, not a verified Flow folder-import action.
Flow asset ID / upload batch / picture number: unbound.

READY CONDITIONS
Finish sorting and choose this input deliberately. Upload the actual file once through Upload, then verify it is visible and record its Flow binding. Add from project can reuse it only after it exists in that project. Confirm image mode, displayed model label, output count, any available aspect setting and cost in the live UI. The screenshot's Format menu was not opened, so its options remain unknown. No other character or outfit image is attached for this baseline.

BASELINE A — ONE STILL, NANO BANANA 2.1
This is our proposed comparison baseline, not an executed result. Retain source composition and framing rather than introducing a pose change immediately. Where a setting is unavailable, record unavailable; do not invent a seed or a hidden control.

Prompt to use only after the actual source is attached:
Create one reference-faithful still of the same Hon Dolo character shown in HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg. Keep the face shape, age, curls, facial hair, expression, skin finish, head angle, crop, clothing, lighting and setting closely matched. Preserve the actual eye lettering under his right eye (viewer-left) and know under his left eye (viewer-right), with their existing size and direction. Preserve the neck blaster with its smoke curl, the visible chest artwork, the two gold upper canine caps with the other upper teeth natural, the metallic lower grill and visible nose, lip and ear jewelry. Let existing clothing occlude the same details. Return one still with no extra characters, new lettering, props or design embellishments. No anatomical third eye, retired bird/Jabba/Chewie/dice motifs, new tattoo reconstruction or actor-likeness replacement.

REVIEW BEFORE ANY EXPANSION
Compare side-by-side at the same displayed scale: facial proportions and hair; exact eye/know text and side; mouth/grill; visible jewelry; neck/chest drawing; clothing and background. Note the location of each mismatch. If the result looks pleasing but alters the identity or required details, mark it failed_preservation rather than accepted. Do not claim exact pixel preservation for a generated image.

CONDITIONAL MODEL COMPARISON B
If A fails a specific required detail, one Nano Banana Pro comparison is proposed. Use the same original input and exact prompt, with matching available framing/resolution/settings. Change only the model and record any settings that cannot be matched. Do not feed A into Pro as an automatic finishing pass; that would test a different operation and could accumulate drift. Keep both originals and report which defects each retains. Stop after this bounded comparison and decide from evidence; do not open a retry batch.

WHY THESE MODELS
Google's current documentation positions 2.1 as the standard fast image model, and Pro for complex designs and detailed control. Our sequence is a practical hypothesis to test, not proof Pro will preserve this character better. 2 Lite remains a separate efficiency option. Check current UI cost before generation. Source checked October 8, 2026: Google Flow models and supported features — https://support.google.com/flow/answer/16352836?hl=en

LATER CHANGE — ONE VARIABLE
After the baseline is reviewed, choose either a very small head turn with the same framing OR a slightly wider crop with the same head pose. Do not change both, introduce a second outfit, add another face or reveal unreferenced hidden tattoos in the same test. A wardrobe reference may later supply clothing alone; it must not overwrite current identity. Use a separately reviewed coherent scene still before testing camera movement or two-person Flow video.

RECORD TO RETURN
Experiment ID; A or B; actual downloaded filename; actual source attachment ID and filename; exact prompt; displayed model; visible format/resolution; output count; displayed cost; settings actually available; output dimensions; file SHA256 computed from actual bytes; defect list; user review state. Leave unavailable values null/unknown. Suggested local result labels FLOW-HD-STILL-001_A_2p1 and FLOW-HD-STILL-001_B_Pro are planning labels, not files that already exist.

AUDIO / TIMING
This is a still test. Later video takes should use no spoken dialogue, singing, invented lyrics or added score. The current supplied song is added separately; soundtrack replacement does not create accurate mouth timing. No song timecode or Caleb lyric change is assigned by this experiment.

FLOW 002 - ZIGGY'S A/B REVIEW CLARIFICATION
October 12, 2026. Transcribed from the user's current review. No new generation.

CURRENT DISPOSITION
A and B need fixes and are not production-approved. No numeric grade was given.
The earlier warmth-only acceptance remains a dated observation. This review
supersedes it as the current disposition: a visible warmer result is a technical
effect, not approval of convincing relighting, acting, likeness or the scene.

A - ORIGINAL SIX-SECOND EXCERPT
FLOW-HD-VIDEO-002-A
SHA256 f8f2aa30265392634b67dbddebdc6ac0f05007de1abb2730f27d27513e72d378
Ziggy finds the outfit perfect and the blue aesthetic beautiful. The actor is
not a sufficient likeness; tattoos are difficult to see, with some neck tattoo
and chain visible. The car entry/descent and body interaction look physically
unrealistic. The picture looks grainy/low resolution to him. That appearance
judgment does not change measured metadata: 1280x720, 24 fps, 144 frames, 6.0s.
It is not a measured 480p source or an accepted identity reference.

B - FLOW WARMTH EDIT
FLOW-HD-VIDEO-002-B
SHA256 8d090aaa5a45cc42cb9d52e7b26d9419a8d8aa8c029c22a1859752ec7e0cf3c2
The warm streetlight change is visible, but reads as a yellow filter/surface
wash rather than source-motivated light with local falloff, coherent shadows
and reflections. A's pre-existing likeness, visibility and physical-motion
defects are inherited; this review does not claim Flow created those defects.
B measures 1280x720, 24 fps, 144 frames, 6.0s video in a 6.02s container. The
existing near-silent AAC measurement remains unchanged; no new listening or
silent-stream claim is made. Actual generation cost remains unknown.

BETTER PROMPT OR BETTER MODEL?
The actual saved prompt requested a "subtle warmer color balance" and asked
Flow to preserve the source's complete motion. It did not distinctly ask for
physical light-source behavior. A global-looking warmth effect alone cannot
tell us that Omni is the wrong model. The requested physically motivated
relight is a different declared lighting change, named separately below.
Root's read-only October 12 inspection reports the same prompt and Omni 1.1
Flash in the current editor; no higher-quality/model or resolution selector
was visible, no menus opened, no settings changed. Alternatives are unverified.
The single proposed diagnostic keeps that model and source so the deliberate
change is the lighting brief. It cannot repair the source's actor or physical
performance while also being a preservation test. Those inherited defects
remain reasons this clip is nonproduction.

ONE FUTURE DIAGNOSTIC - PROPOSED C, NOT SENT
Adapter: FLOW-HD-VIDEO-002-C-MOTIVATED-LIGHTING-PROPOSED.
Use A unchanged again, not B. Compare received B against one C output with A
as their common source. Same Omni 1.1 Flash video-edit mode if currently offered;
one output, six-second input, original-size/1280x720 target. Record offered
controls and any forced differences. Do not invent the unknown original seed.
Inspect the source's actual lighting cues first; verify current mode, displayed
cost and allowance before any future submission. No automatic retry, model
change, upscale or separate motion-repair run follows from this proposal.

BEGIN PROPOSED C PROMPT
Edit the attached six-second source video. Change only its lighting treatment.
Make the existing streetlight illumination gently warmer in a physically
motivated way: localized pools of warm light with distance falloff, coherent
shadows and highlights, and reflections that follow the existing car, jacket

CURRENT UPDATE — FOUR GOLD UPPER CAPS / HEAD LIBRARY, OCTOBER 9
The user's later Grok conversation resolves the dental design: exactly FOUR
gold upper caps, comprising both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines.
The two central upper incisors and other upper teeth remain natural white.
Keep the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops, and the full-face
anchor's nostril placement (one hoop per nostril; no septum substitution).
This supersedes the earlier two-canines-only rule for new work. The two earlier
user close-ups and their original intake observations remain historical evidence;
neither is blanket acceptance of all teeth, nose placement or phoneme geometry.
See ../../head_library_20261009/grok_conversation_evidence.json for the dated
conversation evidence and ../../head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json for
the expected head drop. Shared method: projects/collaborators/character_head_reference_standard.txt.
The head library is reusable across outfits; mouth macros remain separate
detail authority. Planned coverage is not received or accepted media.

GENERATION READINESS
Await a received, inspected corrected primary face/reference set matching the
four-cap rule before using the active prompt below. The older full-face anchor
and its exact crop have the retired dental layout. They still provide identity,
lettering and nose-placement evidence; do not present them as unchanged dental
masters. Register the corrected source ID/hash and any derived crop bounds before
resuming the finite A/B test. Static acceptance does not establish speech fidelity.

HON DOLO — MOUTH CONTINUITY REFERENCE / BOUNDED PROOF
Prepared October 8; current dental adapter updated October 9, 2026.
Awaiting compatible corrected references: no upload, generation, spending or motion acceptance.

PURPOSE
A short close-up showing neutral lips, a modest smile and speech could become a
useful recurring reference and review target for Hon Dolo's grill. Whether it
improves a later generation is a hypothesis to test. A generated reference can
contain errors itself; do not promote it merely because the first frame looks good.

CURRENT REFERENCES AND THEIR ROLES
Paths below are relative to docs/notes/explorable_world/comfy/ in the CFA repo.
Existing face/identity anchor, with now-retired dental layout: HD-DROP-ef5d59a6402e / HD-DESIGN-01,
HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg:
projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/asset_review_20261007/reference_candidates/hon-dolo-armor-swap/HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg
SHA256 ef5d59a6402eaff568e30bb6a4432b14b90c692ea6758a761c7702c44d457978
Use its face details and piercing placement as evidence, not its older tooth
map. This is not a new final Comfy likeness approval. The CURRENT rule is four
GOLD UPPER caps: two lateral incisors plus two SHORT canines, flanking two natural
white central incisors; all other uppers natural. Keep the LOWER SILVER/CHROME
GRILL and two plain lower-lip hoops. No extra gold upper caps, full-gold top row,
iced upper fronts or oversized fangs. Older GRILL-REF-ICED and Lisan's optional
iced grill are different directions. Corrected compatible source files remain
to be received, inspected and registered; none is invented here.

For comparison B only, after the corrected primary reference is registered:
prepare one exact-pixel mouth crop from that same corrected primary image,
including lips, both mouth corners and lip rings. Record crop bounds and hash;
no enhancement, invented teeth or AI repaint. That crop has NOT been made in
this planning task. It is mouth-detail evidence, never a replacement identity.

Existing motion baseline: gemini_generated_video_c0823c60.mp4, user-selected
starting source, not blanket approval of every detail. Master SHA256:
b5deff1982da0cbbdee24a7dfc253fe6825018549a37ca531c7b3586cdbee525
Its already-prepared continuous excerpt is:
projects/hon_dolo_strictly_business/gemini_intake_20261007/source_excerpts/c0823c60_opening_57f.mp4
SHA256 b96cf9cc21274451515e331e432d86851b5fa7a2234fd7e182390a3da22c6e96
57 frames, 24 fps, 2.375 seconds, 1280 x 720; no audio in this excerpt.
It supplies source performance/timing, not a mouth design override.

FIRST: KEEP LIGHTING AND LIP CHANGES SEPARATE
Recorded depth v001 and Canny v002 renders both completed at 1024 x 576,
24 fps / 57 frames. Matched samples show changed mouth shapes, grill, rings,
lettering and background. Canny did not materially solve preservation. Neither
was accepted; full continuous playback/audio quality was not established.

For lighting-only work, first compare the unchanged 57-frame excerpt A with
B using ONE modest non-generative exposure adjustment, e.g. +0.2 stops, with
the source color interpretation retained and all other grading controls fixed.
This planned baseline changes pixel values without asking a generator to redraw
the face. Preserve framing, dimensions, FPS, timestamps and frame count; check
for highlight clipping, lost metal detail and new encoding artifacts. A grade
is not a physically new light or restored detail. No grade has been executed.
If mouth motion/words must change, use a separate lip-sync experiment afterward.

GEMINI REQUEST — ONE TAKE AT A TIME, TWO-TAKE MAXIMUM
Check the actual session's attachment support first; video analysis and a video
generation control input are different capabilities. Ask for one eight-second
take if supported; otherwise record the offered short duration. Do not silently
extend it or start a batch. Keep full-face framing sufficiently close to inspect
the mouth, rather than a disembodied mouth-only shot.

Draft A prompt — use only after the corrected primary reference is registered:
"Create one continuous close-up mouth-continuity proof of this same Hon Dolo.
Keep his full face visible, a fixed frontal camera, plain background and soft
steady neutral light. Preserve the reference face, lettering and piercings.
His four gold upper caps are the two lateral incisors and the two SHORT canines.
His two central upper incisors and all other upper teeth are natural white.
Keep his lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops and one hoop in
each nostril unchanged. Do not introduce a septum ring. Start with lips resting
naturally, give a small relaxed smile,
then say once at an ordinary pace: 'Strictly business. Count it twice.' Relax
again at the end. Preserve believable lip closure and natural tooth occlusion;
teeth need not remain visible through closed lips. No music, camera move,
lighting change, cuts, extra dialogue or jewelry redesign. Aim for eight seconds."

Inspect A before making B. If the actual interface supports a second reference
with this role, B uses the SAME corrected full anchor, prompt and available settings, plus
the exact mouth crop as the ONLY deliberate change. Explain: "The additional
image is a detail crop of the same anchor; use it only for the grill and rings."
Keep seed fixed if exposed; record when it is not. These two stochastic takes
are an exploratory comparison, not statistical proof of a reference benefit.
If the interface cannot accept that role, stop after A and report the limitation.

SUCCESS CHECK / WHEN THIS BECOMES A STAPLE
Review normal-speed playback with audio, then every frame around smile onset,
lip opening/closure and the spoken line. Record exact bad frame/time ranges.
Check exactly four upper gold caps at the lateral incisors and short canines,
two white central incisors, natural other uppers, stable lower silver material/
layout, two plain lip hoops, correct nostril placement, plausible occlusion, unchanged face/lettering,
and words actually heard. A neutral frame passing does not approve speaking.
Any visible tooth/ring duplication, vanishing or design substitution is a fail
for a reusable mouth master. Keep failed takes and their notes; stop at two.
Only after user review, retain an accepted clip plus neutral/smile/speech stills
as MOUTH-REFERENCE candidate/version with source hash, prompt, model, settings,
actual duration and precise approval scope. No such accepted master exists yet.
Then test it on ONE representative production shot; do not mandate it for all
shots until that use shows a benefit. Do not replace the current identity anchor.

COMFY HANDOFF — COMPATIBILITY STILL TO VERIFY
Official LTX-2.3 IA2V takes an image and audio; Union Control uses structural
video guidance plus an appearance image. Those documented roles do not prove
that our saved graph accepts an additional independent moving mouth reference.
Inspect the chosen live Cloud template, model, node sockets and compiled inputs
before connecting it. A mouth reference is useful review evidence even if no
compatible conditioning socket exists. Do not relabel it as motion control.
For existing footage with changed lyrics, retain the separately prepared Sync
lip-sync candidate and exact replacement recording route. It remains unexecuted;
the old 0–2.375-second full-mix trim is not a verified sung phrase or clean vocal.
Listen/select the actual phrase before any run. Soundtrack replacement alone
does not change lips. The completed local stream-copy audio proof preserved
picture; Cloud assembly is saved/validated but unexecuted, and neither proves
grill fidelity under lip sync. Account/schema/cost checks precede paid execution.

SOURCES / REUSABLE LEARNING (reviewed October 8, 2026)
Local: workflows/README.md#choose-by-problem; templates/workflow_intake.md#decision-and-feedback;
workflows/hon_dolo_gemini_relight_v001.record.json and v002.record.json;

https://ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg-filters.html#eq
Google's generation help was found but full retrieval was blocked this pass;
no account-specific multi-reference capability is asserted:
https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16126339
Return actual observations to the existing CFA/Pan manual handoff; no lesson
reopening, provider message or automatic synchronization occurred here.


OCTOBER 9 — GROK STATIC MOUTH RETURN
Twelve generated mouth stills, one contact sheet and five rejected attempts are received and verified. See grok_viseme_return_20261009/visual_review.txt and visual_review.json for the independent inspection, and the shared grok_image_benchmark_20261009 receipt for canonical paths/hashes.

Several open poses exaggerate gold canines/lower-cap geometry; closed poses cannot establish hidden-tooth preservation. Do not adopt the provider's eleven-of-twelve lock claim.

OPENING TRANSACTION — COLLABORATOR VIDEO BENCHMARK
CURRENT DENTAL / HEAD-REFERENCE UPDATE — OCTOBER 9
The user has selected exactly FOUR gold upper caps: both lateral incisors plus
both SHORT canines. The two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain
natural white; keep the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lip hoops, and
original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution).
The old two-canines-only A reference is still recorded below as source history.
Before either still-generation lane, receive and inspect a compatible corrected
primary reference, then replace A and reconcile its exact name/hash and prompt
in this package. Current prompts are drafts, not ready to send with old teeth.
Before any video lane, select one new scene frame matching the current design
and use its same exact bytes across all lanes. Do not claim pixel-preservation
of an old mouth while changing its tooth map. Older originals stay unchanged.
Reuse the accepted head library across outfits, selecting relevant views rather
than attaching every head. Mouth macros remain separate close-detail authority.
Shared method (relative to Comfy): projects/collaborators/character_head_reference_standard.txt.
Expected drop: ../../head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json.
This update changes no job counts and performs no generation.

Prepared October 9, 2026. Planned comparison; no generation, upload or spending performed.

THE QUESTION
Which available service/model gives us the most usable opening shot from the SAME chosen Dolo frame, and what does each need from us? This is a small project benchmark, not a permanent contest on every shot or a universal ranking of video models. Grok's quality is an open question, not a predetermined last place.

REUSE THE EXISTING WORK
Use GROK_STARTING_FRAME.txt and its three exact role-specific references for the still-image screen below. Compare one Grok candidate with one ChatGPT image candidate, then select ONE scene-scoped starting frame, record its filename/hash and give that same frame to every video lane. The selected frame may come from either still creator. Do not let each video provider use its own preferred starting image. No candidate has been generated or selected.

Use CFA's existing templates/workflow_intake.md#decision-and-feedback and templates/run_record.json for actual jobs. Relevant lessons and saved graphs are listed below. This file is the brief for ONE comparison; it introduces no general benchmark engine, new Holy Grail or duplicated hook system. Nyquist remains the home of shared methods; the CFA notebook_workflow/README.txt contains the breadcrumbs. Put only reviewed reusable findings into Notebook0 and the Pan handoff.

STILL-IMAGE SCREEN — INCLUDE CHATGPT
ChatGPT image creation is a real separate entrant. Use the built-in image generation tool available in this session, with the same A/B/C source files and the exact creative request from GROK_STARTING_FRAME.txt. Its Grok title is an operator label, not an instruction to change the scene. Inspect the three local references before passing their paths to the tool. Do not pass historical audit images as extra references. The operator records the returned file/hash/dimensions and any exposed model metadata; do not ask the image itself to contain a receipt.
Plan ONE Grok still and ONE ChatGPT still, no automatic rerolls. Review both at native size and equal display size, keeping identity, hair, visible teeth/grill, tattoos, hands, props, wardrobe and scene observations separate. Select one fit-for-scene frame for ALL video entrants; selection is not global character approval. An image winner has not demonstrated motion or continuation. Other collaborators' still-image models may join a later bounded comparison when a real shot needs it.
The official built-in image documentation names gpt-image-2. This tool offers no model selector, and the exact runtime snapshot remains unknown unless returned as evidence. Use the built-in route; do not silently switch to an API model or open a separate account merely because another model is advertised.
Source: https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/image-generation

ROUND A — FOUR SERVICE LANES
One short first-frame generation per eligible lane:
1. Gemini app — record the actual model/mode shown. Current Google help describes Gemini Omni and multi-turn editing; the precise account model is unverified.
2. Flow — proposed initial choice Veo 3.1 Fast, in Video / Frames / start frame only. Record the actual label. If unavailable, choose an offered first-frame model before running and record the substitution.
3. Grok — use the actual consumer video mode/model offered. Do not assume Chief-of-Staff text chat exposes the API model/settings. Record unavailable fields as unknown.
4. Comfy Cloud — adapt the existing Hon Dolo Motion Test image-to-video graph, using the saved LTX-2.5 baseline as the starting recipe. Fresh model/node/compiled-input verification is still required. Comfy is the workflow host, not the model name.

The first wave is at most FOUR video jobs, one output each. An unavailable lane is deferred, not assigned a quality score of zero. Record estimates before submission and actual consumption afterward; the planned job count does not imply zero cost, a purchased allowance or unlimited retries. The still-image screen is separate: one already-planned Grok request plus one ChatGPT image entry.

ROUND B — FLOW'S MODEL CHOICES
After reviewing the first wave, compare other actually offered Flow video models with the same frame, prompt and effective settings. Current documentation lists Veo 3.1 Lite, Fast, Quality and Gemini Omni Flash 1.1. That is four documented video choices, not proof of what appears in this account; the page also lists three image models. Inspect Video mode before identifying the user's remembered three choices.

At most THREE additional short jobs cover the remaining documented choices if they are available and worth the comparison. The current four-service-plus-Flow screen is capped at seven video outputs. Reserve ONE additional ChatGPT video entry only if an actual accessible native video generator is verified, making the conditional maximum eight; do not replace it with a Comfy job labeled ChatGPT. This is not ten continuations multiplied across every model. Do not duplicate Fast if it already ran in Round A. Use first-frame conditioning, not Ingredients: those modes are not supported equivalently across the documented models.

Within Flow, change the model alone where possible. If that forces resolution, audio, seed or other settings to change, record those changes and label the comparison as a configuration comparison. Across different services, this is an end-to-end workflow comparison; their hidden defaults prevent claiming a clean single-variable experiment. A shared seed number across unrelated models does not create matched randomness. One take per lane gives an initial screen, not a reliable estimate of failure rate. Any later repeatability check needs a separately bounded round with equal attempts and all failures retained.

COMMON INPUT AND CONTROLS
Target: one continuous eight-second landscape shot, 16:9, first-frame input only, one output. Eight seconds is the proposed common test duration, replacing the earlier approximate ten-second initial target for this benchmark only. The ten-turn story plan remains one creation plus nine continuations; it is not a duration promise.
Use the same selected 16:9 source bytes wherever supported. Prefer native 1280x720 where every lane offers it; do not pretend a forced size or LTX frame-grid duration is identical. Record source, conditioning and native output dimensions separately. If a service needs a resized input, create one documented deterministic derivative shared by all lanes in that comparison, or mark the lane unmatched. No silent crop, outpaint or identity repaint.
Set duration in the actual control when present; prompt wording alone does not set a parameter. At 24 fps a Comfy frame grid may require a nearby duration: preserve its actual frame count/timebase and report the difference. Do not loop, speed up, interpolate or stretch a shorter clip to disguise a mismatch. Compare complete native clips for usability and a clearly labeled common-time viewing window for matched review.
No extra identity references, ending frame, motion-control video, character LoRA, prompt enhancement, retouch, upscale or lip-sync in the common baseline. Disable optional enhancement when possible; preserve entered and effective prompts if rewriting is unavoidable. Any mandatory provider behavior is an observed difference. A provider's best multi-reference recipe belongs in a later tuned-workflow round.
No generated dialogue, rap or music. Quiet room tone may be unavoidable; judge picture muted first, then inspect audio separately. Audio support is a separate capability, not a hidden bonus in the image-quality score.

BEGIN SHARED PROMPT
Animate the attached selected starting frame as one continuous eight-second opening shot for the Strictly Business transaction. Keep the same Hon Dolo, studded armor vest, substantial chain, ship counter, lighting and camera placement. He is the only visible person; the customer stays offscreen near the lens. Exactly four matching warm-gold luminous rectangular credit pieces lie separately on the counter. No banknotes or coins.

Dolo looks from the credits toward the implied customer, gives a restrained businesslike half-smile, then lowers his gaze toward the money. His character-right index finger moves naturally to hover just above the first piece, ready to count. End poised there. The credits remain still and separate; do not complete the count or transaction yet. Keep both hands and their plausible anatomy visible.

Preserve the starting frame's face, curly hair, skin, lowercase cheek lettering, smoking blaster on his character-left neck, visible chest artwork and piercings. If teeth become visible, keep exactly four gold upper caps at the two lateral incisors and two SHORT canines; the two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain natural white. Preserve the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops and original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution). Teeth may naturally disappear behind closed lips. Do not add tattoos, jewelry, people, props or readable text.

Fixed medium camera, same side of the counter, same aspect ratio and set geometry. No cuts, zoom, mirror flip, wardrobe change, reframing, loop or fade. Subtle natural breathing and believable hand motion. No speech, singing or music; quiet room tone only if sound is generated. Return one video and stop.
END SHARED PROMPT

This is also TURN_01 in GEMINI_10_TURNS.txt: generate it once. A passing Gemini benchmark take can serve as the continuation parent. Record the actual output facts in RUN_PLAN.json before starting turn 02. If it ends in a materially different state, reconcile the continuation plan instead of assuming compatibility. The gentle first shot screens identity and instruction-following; it does not by itself prove complex money handling or talking-mouth fidelity.

REVIEW CARD — SAME QUESTIONS FOR EVERY RESULT
Watch the original in normal-speed playback, then inspect the start, middle, end, finger movement and any visible defect. Use neutral review labels A/B/C/... before revealing provider names where practical. Native watermarks may make blinding incomplete; retain them and note the limit.
Score each supported category 0-4: 0 unusable/broken, 1 major defects, 2 mixed/repair needed, 3 usable with minor defects, 4 clean for this shot. Use N/A for a feature not exposed; do not infer grill fidelity from closed lips or full-body continuity from a medium shot.
- Identity and scoped details: face/hair, lettering, visible tattoo shapes, rings and visible teeth.
- Hands and objects: anatomy, finger movement, four stable rectangular credits and consistent scale/contact if any occurs.
- Temporal continuity: flicker, morphing, duplication, disappearing pieces, wardrobe/set drift.
- Instruction-following: specified gaze/hand sequence, fixed camera, one person, no invented words/cuts.
- Cinematic usefulness: readable intention, natural performance, usable beginning/end and visual quality at native size.
For every defect, record the time/frame, severity and source comparison. A serious identity substitution or impossible hand/credit event fails reusable-shot acceptance even if the clip looks beautiful. Keep the individual scores and Ziggy's preference; do not hide tradeoffs in one grand winner number.

Also record actual duration/resolution/FPS; requested versus delivered output count; request/queue/completion times where observable; credits/currency and whether estimated or actually attributed; retries; operator effort; download integrity; and real model/version/graph evidence. Subscription credits are not automatically comparable dollars. Unknown values remain unknown. A new generation failure is an outcome to retain, not a reason to quietly buy another attempt.

CONTINUATION IS A SEPARATE CAPABILITY TEST
After the short-shot screen, test one continuation for a selected route using its actual passing parent and TURN_02's count-the-four-credits action. Require growing duration, retained earlier sequence, a coherent join and the complete cumulative output. Record original duration, added duration, parent lineage, prefix comparison and defects. Editing, appending and external stitching receive different labels.
Gemini's existing ten-turn package remains available if the continuation test passes. It does not authorize a ten-turn chain for every contender. A Gemini baseline reused as TURN_01 leaves at most nine further calls in that existing chain; do not count or generate it again.
Flow currently documents extension through Veo 3.1 Lite for eligible eight-second Veo 3.1 clips, even when the parent was Fast/Quality. That is a mixed-model chain and must be labeled. Omni editing is not proof of append-only extension. Grok API extension support does not prove the consumer interface exposes it. Do not invent a Comfy extension socket or claim concatenating outputs is native continuation.

LEARN SPECIALTIES BY SCENE AND DETAIL
Use the capability map in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json alongside the existing run records. Every cell starts untested, with no provider assigned as the best choice. Image and video findings stay separate. Grow this map through actual storyboard work instead of generating every scene with every model at once.
- Opening transaction: the current single-person ship-counter proof, restrained expression and hand movement. It does not establish bar-scene, walking, crowd or talking-mouth ability.
- One person seated at a bar: face/hair, posture, outfit, atmosphere, glass/hand contact and visible teeth/grill when actually exposed.
- One person moving: face/hair/detail preservation while body or camera moves. Native continuation receives its own prefix/join checks.
- Two people interacting: distinct identities, eyelines, contact, which hands belong to whom and ownership of props.
- Crowd: foreground identity, occlusion, duplicated people and background consistency.
Record hair SHAPE/texture and hair TEMPORAL preservation separately. Do the same for facial identity, tattoos, grill/teeth, jewelry, hands, object count/contact and environment. A hidden grill is not observable, not a passing grill test. A static image cannot pass temporal checks.
A recommendation should say what worked, for which scene/camera/motion/configuration, with run IDs, sample count, failures and uncertainty. One strong bar take can make that model a candidate for similar shots; one weak group take does not justify a permanent ban on groups. Retest only when the next production decision needs it. Model/version changes may invalidate an old preference.
Later we can explicitly test a mixed workflow, such as ChatGPT still -> Flow animation -> Comfy finishing. Keep that new pipeline's evidence separate from the common-frame baseline. Review every handoff for preserved identity/details, since combining individually strong tools does not guarantee a strong chain. Return useful measured routing lessons to Notebook0 through the existing workflow; project-specific art/approval remains local.

MY / NOVA'S ENTRY
ChatGPT is included directly for still images. Its native video entry is conditional: this Codex session currently has no connected standalone video-generation tool, and no ChatGPT account video mode has been verified. If an accessible native route is verified when we run, give it the SAME chosen frame/prompt, identify its actual model and include one take. A still, slideshow, or Comfy output does not count as that entry.
Nova directs and operates the runs. A Nova-directed Comfy variant can later test whether one justified workflow change improves a baseline, with the actual backend and extra effort disclosed. It would be a workflow/tuning comparison, not a fifth independent model wearing a Codex label.
The documented OpenAI Sora 2 / Sora 2 Pro / Videos API shutdown date was September 24, 2026. As of this plan, that API is not an available fifth lane. Old model and guide pages remaining online do not establish availability. No API keys or new accounts were requested.
Source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations

OTHER CONTENDERS / CIVITAI
Consider a genuinely different video family only after this first screen answers something useful. Favor a compatible existing Comfy template over another account or duplicated infrastructure. The saved MiniMax H3 discovery is a candidate for a later Comfy comparison, not verified current compatibility. A documented Kling route is another candidate if it supplies a useful distinct capability; see the dated source notes in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json.
Civitai can supply particular models/adapters/workflows through the existing intake. Record the actual base model, adapter, compatible architecture and effective graph. Merely replacing an example image does not prove that a package can preserve Dolo, and another storefront is not automatically another model. Keep a decorated/tuned recipe separate from the plain baseline. No registration, model import, package execution or account upload is needed to prepare this comparison.

SAVED COMFY BASELINE AND EXISTING LESSONS
Problem-to-recipe: workflows/README.md#choose-by-problem, "Animate an existing still into a new short shot."
Saved workflow: https://cloud.comfy.org/#bfe78175-2366-4a28-bb76-518c89bef525
Record: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.record.json; editor: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.editor.json; executed graph: workflows/hon_dolo_motion_v001.executed.api.json. Paths and hashes are in BENCHMARK_PLAN.json. The old 960x512 / 24 fps / 97-frame motion test completed with eye/smile drift in sampled frames and no final acceptance. Its actual ratio was 15:8 despite a widescreen selector label. This is evidence that the old recipe ran, not an eight-second, 16:9 benchmark result or current Cloud compatibility.
The saved graph uses intrinsic latent x2 refinement. Preserve and disclose the model's required internal stages; "no upscale" here excludes optional output finishing, not a hidden removal of the saved model's normal generation stages. Prefer the recovered editor over the upstream snapshot's stale embedded prompt. Do not carry its old source frame or duration into the new run.
Use ../Pan_Handlers/Help/content/video_routes.py (image_to_video), guides/sampling_lab.py and guides/workflow_decision.py through CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md / FILE_MAP.md, relative to the CFA checkout. Review actual Cloud models, node schema, compiled inputs and cost before execution. Native Comfy tools were not callable in this preparation, so live dependency status remains unknown. An old zero-credit API-node estimate was not proof of free native GPU execution. Model weights stay in Cloud; necessary native media and records stay on D:.

CURRENT SOURCE NOTES / LIVE-ACCOUNT LIMITS
Google Gemini video generation: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16126339?hl=en
Flow model/feature matrix: https://support.google.com/flow/answer/16352836?hl=en-KE
Flow first-frame controls: https://support.google.com/flow/answer/16353334?hl=en
Flow browser inspection failed at runtime initialization twice, before any account UI was read. Exact account models, labels, costs and current selections are unverified. Documentation is not an account receipt. No quality ranking or new generation exists yet.

This update changes no job counts and performs no generation.

Prepared plan, not executed. Use one chosen conversation and the actual selected shared benchmark frame. Do not paste all ten requests at once. "Verified" below means inspected as fit to continue this prototype, not a new canonical approval.

TURN 01 is the exact shared prompt from BENCHMARK.txt. Reuse a passing Gemini benchmark take; do not submit it twice. It now targets eight seconds for the common comparison. The ten-turn count is unchanged.

BEFORE TURN 01
First verify the selected frame reflects the current four-gold design, then identify that exact frame by filename/hash in RUN_PLAN.json. Attach that file directly in the generation composer; a notebook text source or a path string is not proof that the image is available as generation input. The three original Grok references are recorded separately; avoid flooding Gemini with conflicting historical pictures. The common benchmark uses this one frame only. Additional identity inputs belong to a separately labeled tuned-workflow round.

Check the mode without generating: can it use this image, offer the eight-second benchmark target, and later CONTINUE the result rather than merely regenerate/edit it? Record what the interface actually offers. Official multi-turn editing documentation does not guarantee prefix preservation. Do not silently switch to Flow, an API, a paid new service or a stitching route.

SCENE CONTRACT FOR EVERY TURN
One Dolo, seated at the same ship counter, same studded vest/chain, current face/hair/tattoos/grill/rings. One implied customer offscreen, no visible extra person or extra hand. Four identical warm-gold luminous rectangular credits, no banknotes/coins. Medium fixed camera on the same side, same aspect ratio, light, set geometry and object scale; no cuts, reframing, zoom, mirror flip or wardrobe change. Restrained expressions, believable hand contact. No dialogue, singing, generated music, captions or new readable screens. Use only optional quiet room tone. Lyrics express the story beat; exact song audio and lip sync are separate later work.

OPERATOR GATE AFTER EVERY TURN
Inspect normal-speed video and listen to its actual audio; examine hands/credits, face, lettering, mouth/rings and the join. Record dimensions, FPS/timebase if measurable, duration, frame count if measurable, filename/hash and observed defects. Unknown stays unknown. The next turn starts from the ACTUAL final pose, not merely the requested pose. If it materially missed this turn's end state or changes the planned blocking, stop and revise the plan instead of blindly sending the next card.

For turns 02-10, compare the returned native file against the previous verified parent: duration must grow, earlier content must remain in order without truncation/loop/retiming, and the join must be coherent. Review the full prefix at normal speed plus aligned samples and the join frame-by-frame. If exact decoded frame/timestamp hashes agree, record exact preservation; if the provider re-encodes them, do not call the prefix pixel-identical. Record the measured differences and visual assessment. If it rewrites material, only returns a disconnected suffix, or cannot be inspected/downloaded, STOP. Do not label regeneration or local concatenation a successful native extension. Keep the last verified parent and report the limitation.

These prepared limits are not execution or spending authorization. During an authorized run, Nova may inspect each returned take and proceed autonomously within the agreed limits. A passing routine check does not need another user confirmation; pause for an actual failure, missing capability or unresolved creative choice. Ten prompts is a maximum route, not a promised duration or compulsory ten-run batch. Stop early if the opening beat is complete. No automatic retries or extra rounds. Select the next block only after the gate passes.

His character-right index finger moves naturally to hover just above the first piece, ready to count. End poised there. My attached images have these roles: A = HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg (HD-DROP-ef5d59a6402e), legacy face/details with obsolete dental layout pending replacement; B = REF-cash-source.jpg (HD-DROP-2691712601a9), studded vest/chain/ship-counter only; C = SB-03-pay-table.jpg (HD-DROP-36679ee9953b), luminous rectangular credits/transaction only. These labels do not depend on attachment order.

Create ONE 16:9 cinematic starting-frame candidate for Hon Dolo's opening "Strictly Business" transaction. No batch, video, turnaround or additional cast.

Use the reconciled attachment A for Hon Dolo face, curly hair, age, skin, tattoo placement and piercing placement. The current four-cap tooth map below is required; a historical two-canine picture must not override it. Use B only for the studded black armor-vest construction, substantial gold chain, ship-interior counter, lighting and seated cash-counting attitude. Use C only for the shape/material of the luminous rectangular credits and the money-on-table transaction idea. The corrected A wins identity/detail conflicts; do not restore obsolete teeth from historical A, B or C. Do not blend the old face or tattoos from B or C into him.

Make a medium frontal three-quarter view, wide enough to see his face, both forearms, both hands and the counter clearly. He is the only identifiable person. The customer is implied off camera; no customer hand enters. Keep the camera on one side of the table and leave enough stillness and space for a later continuous counting performance. Retain B's worn ship setting and actual studded/panelled armor vest; do not turn it into a plain leather waistcoat or change the room. Replace its banknotes, coins and scattered cash with exactly FOUR matching slim luminous warm-gold rectangular credit pieces, all fully visible and separate in a loose row on the counter. No conventional cash remains. His fingertips hover near the row, ready to begin; the credit pieces are not fused to the hands. Propose a small dim unlabelled fuel-status light/bar in the existing console area if it fits without rebuilding the set. Keep it secondary and fixed. No invented readable screens, captions or title text.

Preserve A's lowercase "eye" on character-right cheek (viewer-left), "know" on character-left cheek (viewer-right), and the single smoking blaster on character-left neck (viewer-right). Use only the visible chest-ship treatment from A where this neckline reveals it; do not invent the unseen complete drawing or substitute a compass/mandala. No brow dice, Chewie lettering, bird, Jabba, third eye or added tattoos. Exactly FOUR gold UPPER caps: both lateral incisors and both SHORT canines. The two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain natural white. Keep the LOWER silver/chrome grill, two plain lower-lip hoops without ball ends, one hoop per nostril and A's ear jewelry; no septum substitution. Natural lip closure may hide the teeth. No all-gold upper row, diamond upper fronts, oversized vampire fangs, new jewelry or extra exposed weapons. Keep the chain's weight and the vest's studs/panels. Any hip prop can remain outside this waist-up frame; cropped hips do not prove gun/no-gun status.

His expression is calm, skeptical and businesslike, a small closed-mouth half-smile rather than a big grin. Hands need plausible fingers, contact and perspective. Credit geometry, count and glow must be readable and suitable for continuity checks.

This is a deliberately new frame with combined, scoped references. Do not present it as an unchanged edit or approved master. The previous REV-HD-001 lost the studded vest, thinned the chain and redrew the scene; HIP-CASH-01 invented screen text and drifted toward a compass-like chest. Avoid those defects. They are audit evidence, not alternate masters to copy.

Return just the one actual still plus a short receipt naming the exact A/B/C references used, actual output filename, actual dimensions, model/seed if exposed, and any visible deviations. Supply a real SHA256 only if computed, otherwise unknown. If an attachment is inaccessible, stop and name it instead of claiming it was seen. Do not continue to video or further variants until this frame is reviewed.

REVIEW BEFORE GEMINI (operator)
Face/hair match A; vest/chain/set match B's scoped features; four luminous rectangles match C's prop direction; current lettering/neck/visible chest/mouth/rings intact; no extra body/person, readable screen invention, conventional money or malformed hand. Record actual defects and whether this one frame is usable for the prototype. Selection for this scene does not approve every reference as a complete character look.

HON DOLO — OPENING MONEY SCENE / CONTINUATION PROTOTYPE
CURRENT WORKSHOP STATUS — OCTOBER 9 LOCAL / OCTOBER 10 UTC
The user has authorized a workshop followed by the bounded Gemini continuation
test. The current workshop packet is prepared at
../../../collaborators/storyboard_detail_20261009/01_hon/workshop_current_20261009/.
Read CURRENT_BRIEF.txt, IMAGE_MANIFEST.json and OPERATOR_NOTE.txt there first.
Automatic approval review initially rejected the exact six-image upload to the
existing Hon setup chat. The user has now explicitly approved that exact payload;
upload and visual verification are in progress, not yet verified. No completed
workshop submission or storyboard response is recorded, and no consolidated
starting frame or video output is selected or accepted for this run.
Planning uses the existing setup chat https://gemini.google.com/app/988990050e4ad32c.
The recorded production chat is https://gemini.google.com/app/75a1bed38a68132b;
inspect its live mode/state before a new opening test and do not accidentally
continue its unrelated earlier scene.

Current scoped inputs include lf_full (HD-RETURN-6c8900223ee9) for the no-dice
face/look direction, four-gold macro HD-B-91ef00348229 for teeth/lip hoops, and
SB-06 (HD-DROP-b18c4a123579) for the visible gold curb wrist chain and dark band.
Older teeth in lf_full do not override the macro. Keep cursive eye on character-
right/viewer-left and serif know on character-left/viewer-right. Wrist side,
hidden clasp and final Leigh hand-art transfer remain unresolved. One hoop per
nostril and the face reference's ear jewelry are targets; minor nose/ear
variation alone is not an automatic reroll. The optional iced r4/no-lip-ring
quarters look does not apply to this external-off opening.

The workshop will reconcile the worn counter/cantina evidence against this
older ship-counter/studded-vest proposal. Setting, wardrobe and blocking below
remain proposals until that review. Use a small compatible reference subset;
completion of all 130 heads is not required to workshop or prepare one scene.
The historical A/B/C labels below are not the current six-image workshop map.
The earlier still screen and multi-provider benchmark are separate plans and
are not automatically reopened by the authorized Gemini workshop/ten-turn run.
Preserve the existing one-plus-nine ceiling, no automatic retries and every
per-turn review/continuation stop rule while reconciling the actual prompts.

CURRENT DENTAL / HEAD-REFERENCE UPDATE — OCTOBER 9
The user has selected exactly FOUR gold upper caps: both lateral incisors plus
both SHORT canines. The two central upper incisors and all other uppers remain
natural white; keep the lower silver/chrome grill, two plain lip hoops, and
original nostril placement (one hoop per nostril, no septum substitution).
The old two-canines-only A reference is still recorded below as source history.
Before either still-generation lane, reconcile and inspect compatible current
face and mouth references, then replace A and reconcile exact names/hashes and prompt
in this package. Current prompts are drafts, not ready to send with old teeth.
Before any video lane, select one new scene frame matching the current design
and use its same exact bytes across all lanes. Do not claim pixel-preservation
of an old mouth while changing its tooth map. Older originals stay unchanged.
Reuse reviewed head references across outfits, selecting relevant views rather
than attaching every head. A complete accepted head library is not yet recorded;
mouth macros remain separate close-detail authority.
Shared method (relative to Comfy): projects/collaborators/character_head_reference_standard.txt.
Expected drop: ../../head_library_20261009/expected_intake.json.
This update changes no job counts and performs no generation.

Prepared October 9, 2026; workshop context refreshed October 10 UTC. This continuation run remains unsent and unexecuted, with no accepted starting frame. Exact workshop-upload approval is received; upload and visual checks remain in progress.

START HERE
1. Reconcile the corrected current primary reference as described above, then attach the three exact role-specific images in the updated GROK_STARTING_FRAME.txt when proceeding. It requests ONE Grok still, not a cast search. For the separate ChatGPT image entry, use the same creative brief and same three reference files with the built-in image tool; one candidate per still creator. The recommendation is current Hon Dolo in the existing studded cash-counting vest, at one ship counter, handling the luminous rectangular credits from SB-03.
2. Inspect the Grok and ChatGPT still candidates. Preserve both actual files, hashes and review notes. Select ONE shared frame from either creator only for this prototype if it passes the listed checks; this does not make it the project-wide identity master. If it fails, stop and record the specific correction. No automatic rerolls are included.
3. Use BENCHMARK.txt to compare the same selected frame and opening action in Gemini, Flow, Grok and the saved Comfy LTX-2.5 recipe. Target eight seconds in each actual control where supported; record forced differences. Round A currently has four video lanes; up to three additional Flow models form a later screen. ChatGPT native video is reserved as one extra entry only if an actual accessible generator is verified. Still-image and scene-specialty findings stay separate, as defined in BENCHMARK.txt. Nothing has run. BENCHMARK_PLAN.json records the planned lanes and dated capability evidence. The Gemini prompt is also turn 01 in GEMINI_10_TURNS.txt: generate it once and reuse a passing result.
4. Review turn 01, then try turn 02 only in a mode that can actually continue the existing video. Check that the returned native video is longer and retains the previous sequence. Stop if it replaces, rewrites, loops or truncates earlier footage. The remaining eight prompts depend on that test passing and on each previous result passing review.

WHAT THE TEN TURNS MEAN
One creation plus nine possible continuations of the SAME opening transaction. They are separate requests with a review between them, not a command to run ten generations blindly. During an authorized run Nova performs those checks and continues autonomously within the agreed bounds; passing checks do not require ten separate user confirmations. Pause for a real failure, unavailable capability or unresolved creative choice. The initial image screen is one Grok still plus one ChatGPT still. The continuation package remains at most ten Gemini video attempts, including the shared benchmark creation. The broader comparison has its separate finite bounds in BENCHMARK.txt; it does not multiply this ten-turn chain across providers. This bound is not execution or spending authorization; no service action is taken by preparing this package. Any rejected generation ends this prototype until a new decision; it does not authorize replacement attempts beyond the bound. Stop early if the opening beat is complete, the extension limit is reached or a check fails.

This explores the opening storyboard idea, roughly the first tenth in narrative terms: Strictly business / Count it twice / Pay me up front / Fuel costs extra. S01B (Count it twice) is the primary shot; S01A supplies attitude/context. The opening uses SB-01 through SB-04 concepts. The existing S01B crosswalk also includes later panel SB-19 as semantic reuse; that association is retained, not treated as an audio position. It is not an exact music trim or a requirement for 80, 90 or 100 seconds. The refreshed working song is 234.960 seconds; old section timestamps belong to the previous recording and are not valid edit points. Do not retime the song to fit the experiment. Keep the opening swagger convincing; the later sacrifice for love remains the larger story, not an early heroic reveal.

CAPABILITY CHECK
Google's current help describes reference inputs and multi-turn video editing. It does not promise append-only extension, an immutable prefix, fixed increments or a cumulative export of any requested length. Check the actual account/mode and returned file. Prior user-reported cumulative clips are useful evidence to test, not a guarantee for this run.
Source reviewed October 9: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16126339?hl=en

PICTURE AND AUDIO
Use no generated dialogue or rap in this first proof. Natural restrained breathing/room tone is optional; no generated song. Mouth motion should remain relaxed, with only small smiles. This isolates the transaction and hand/credit continuity. Lyrics guide the action; they are not a request to invent a replacement vocal performance. Exact words, sung timing and audio selection come later from the actual recording.

WHAT COMFY COULD ADD AFTERWARD
For the head-to-head baseline, Comfy first generates its own shot from the same starting frame using LTX-2.5. The options below are a separate later finishing pass, not advantages added only to one raw comparison take.
Comfy is optional finishing, not a reason to redraw a good Gemini take. The saved native Audio Replace graph is server-converted with live inputs/schemas checked, but unexecuted in Cloud. A separate local ten-second stream-copy proof preserved all 240 picture frames/timestamps and compressed picture packets while replacing the full soundtrack. That proves local picture preservation, not lyric alignment or lip sync. Whole-track replacement also removes ambience unless deliberately rebuilt. Native Cloud frame assembly re-encodes picture. The separate lip-sync candidate is unexecuted; it needs an exact checked vocal/phrase and separate mouth/grill review. Depth and Canny relight tests drifted in the small details, so they are not a preservation-safe default. Recheck any chosen live graph before a future run; this package performs none.
Evidence: workflows/hon_dolo_audio_replace_v001.README.md and .record.json; workflows/hon_dolo_gemini_relight_v001.record.json and v002.record.json, relative to the Comfy folder.
Lesson applied: Pan_Handlers/Help/guides/video_handoff.py via CFA_TUTORIAL_LEDGER.md and FILE_MAP.md. The distinction is source picture, exact replacement audio, then optional mouth change.

DELIVERY
Deliver one longest VERIFIED cumulative native video, with its real filename/hash/duration and lightweight per-turn receipts from RUN_PLAN.json. If only turn 01 passes, deliver that proof and report extension blocked; do not call separate clips or a stitched edit a native cumulative continuation. Measured prefix checks may require temporary parent/candidate downloads at each turn. Designate only the final passing take as the permanent master; keep earlier downloads only when needed for comparison/failure evidence; do not delete, overwrite or rename user source files. No automatic export to another collaborator, public posting or project-wide approval.

Use this current brief for this handoff. It replaces the old generic twelve-concept request for this work. Dated Grok notes and old tattoo-era pictures remain evidence, not higher-priority instructions. Keep all source files unchanged. These files have been prepared locally; nobody is claiming they are already attached to your session.

READ FIRST
1. requests.json: exact scoped requests, current detail rules and the staged seven-still correction/Caleb maximum; boss discovery is separate.
2. asset_map.json: actual source IDs, exact filenames, SHA256 values, package paths and allowed roles. Confirm the actual attachments are readable. Never map a bare chat number by upload order.
3. panel_plan.txt: five proposed boss beats and four proposed Caleb beats. Caleb's first master is initial; all boss panels wait for boss selection.
4. return_manifest.template.json: complete it for your return ZIP. Null means unknown; hashes must come from actual file bytes.

ADDITIONAL INCLUDED CONTEXT
GROK_DESIGN_INSTRUCTIONS.txt is the current creative rule. review_context/ contains the saved favorite sweep, selective prop requests, detail profiles and boss-discovery plan. audit/ contains the full image-by-image tattoo audit JSON and readable findings, with its own stated inspection limits. The audit covers the existing 422 catalog images at overview level, with its separately recorded individual views; the fresh Grok500 drop is excluded and its intake is pending. These maps cover more images than this package carries: only thirteen input images are attached here. Wider audit records are not proof that those images are available in your session. Ask for an exact missing source by ID and filename when needed. Multiverse findings are history/variant metadata; they do not authorize a Prime redesign or attach the Multiverse armor image. Use the separate boss-discovery ZIP for all three discovery references.

WHAT WE WANT NOW
- REV-HD-001: correct current tattoos/details on REF-cash-source.jpg; preserve cash-counting vest, ship interior, table, money and lighting.
- REV-HD-002: same current-detail correction on REF-coat-source.jpg; preserve the black overcoat, night boarding ramp and atmosphere.
- REV-HD-003: prepare REF-pinstripe-source.jpg for a boss meeting. Keep the navy three-piece, tie/bar, pocket square, watch and polished mood. Correct visible neck/face/grill/jewelry drift; do not expose the covered chest.
- REV-HD-004: preserve REF-saloon-source.jpg fringe outfit and saloon while fixing the malformed visible hip blaster/holster. Return one corrected matching front/three-quarter outfit view plus one hip detail. The prop should read as a coherent fictional sci-fi blaster seated in its holster with sensible visible attachment and overlap. Retain the depicted side for this proof and label it; a permanent hip-side decision is pending.
- SC-BOSS-001: HOLD. Hippo, gecko-frog and original slug are alternatives for boss discovery. Follow boss_discovery_20261008.txt: fifty concepts in five reviewed rounds of ten; select the winner, then front/back/left/right. Only afterward make the pinstripe two-person meeting proof. The earlier Jabba-only/no-roster instruction is superseded.
- SC-CAL-001: one neutral Caleb K reference and one coherent Hon Dolo + Caleb saloon master. Caleb is a new middle-aged white male lawyer, with no supplied real-person likeness. Use HD-SALOON-01-chest-up.jpg as the selected Hon Dolo outfit/bar-scene alpha, not blanket tattoo approval. Friendly, nonviolent interaction, clear separate faces and eyelines.

CURRENT DESIGN / DO NOT MIX ERAS
HD-EXP-LOCK-FACE.jpg (HD-DESIGN-01; asset HD-DROP-ef5d59a6402e) is the current visible design reference for these corrections. In its frontal view: eye is under character-right eye (viewer-left); know is under character-left eye (viewer-right); smoke/blaster is on character-left neck (viewer-right). Use the visible ship treatment, gold upper canine caps with the other upper teeth natural, metallic lower grill and current visible jewelry. Match actual placement, angle and size; do not guess a font or mirror sides.

Bird/Jabba tattoos, Chewie lettering, dice, literal third eye and Captain/Falcon wording are excluded from this default pass. A possible future bird variant is an idea held aside, not permission to restore it. The current face reference does not reveal all hands, forearms, back, chest or piercings. Report unknowns. No actor-likeness swap is requested in this package; that is a separate Comfy task.

STENCIL RECOVERY — WHAT THE INVENTORY ACTUALLY FOUND
We received thirteen files named stencil-*: three blaster/chest photo placement sheets and ten retired-era face crops with dice filenames. All thirteen are RGB without alpha. Some dice-named candidates actually show Chewie/bird details, and candidate-4 includes the rejected third eye. Filenames do not prove the artwork content. The combined file named stencil-scoundrel-blaster-ship-sheet.png shows neck/chest crops, not a recovered Scoundrel forearm drawing. Do not call any of those original transparent stencils.

SHIP-TATTOO-REF-05.jpg and SHIP-SCHEMATIC-REF.jpg are real received drawings on white JPEG backgrounds, but depict different geometry/viewpoints. Their presence does not settle the current chest drawing or prove original editable art. Resolve the conflict explicitly; do not merge them automatically.

For ST-HD-EYE, ST-HD-KNOW, ST-HD-BLASTER and ST-HD-SHIP: recover genuine standalone source art if available. Return exact original plus transparent PNG and flat black-on-white exports where possible. Include actual front/left/right placement evidence, labeling character-side and viewer-side. A crop is derived_crop with parent hash/bounds, not source art. If the original does not exist, report original_missing. A later reconstruction must be explicitly named proposed_reconstruction, traceable to a source, and left for review; no new tracing/generation is in this recovery pass. Do not invent hidden anatomy or exact real-world dimensions.

REC-HD-ORIGINALS: try to recover exact originals #101, #103, #107 and #206, plus #112/#116/#117/#121 and #152/#154 if recoverable. They were conversational references, not verified numbered files in our drop. Do not relabel a new recreation as the missing original. #101/#103 tattoo history remains historical. Report forearm Scoundrel and right-hand Leigh/card source gaps rather than filling them from imagination.

STORY / AUDIO
The greedy smuggler eventually pays the price for love. The early money/boss beats build the irony. The remembered Caleb cue, "That's my dog dipped in flavor, Caleb K", is a proposed approximate cue absent from the verified lyric master. Do not insert it, assign timing or make him speak it. CREATIVE FREEDOM / COMPANION ART
New character discovery may invent tattoos, piercings, missing limbs and other distinctive features without a permission-first gate. Every new tattoo arrives with a FOUR-OPTION standalone design sheet in the SAME DELIVERY, matching option identified; label derived reconstruction honestly. Expand to 10-12 only when Ziggy asks. Existing Prime correction tasks still preserve their established detail map. Recovering existing artwork is separate from creative design. See GROK_DESIGN_INSTRUCTIONS.txt.

BOUNDED ORDER / QUALITY GATE
Start with REV-HD-001 and review detail drift before the other corrections. Then finish REV-HD-002/003/004 plus the hip detail. The correction/Caleb batch has seven initial character/scene/detail stills: four revisions, one hip detail, Caleb neutral and Caleb master. First boss discovery round has ten single character proofs only, plus required tattoo sheets if tattoos are invented; pause for feedback before each later round. No fifty four-view sets. Additional coverage follows accepted first masters. No unbounded retries.

RETURN ZIP — SINGLE ROOT, EXACT FILENAMES

List every actual returned file in RETURN_MANIFEST.json, with request_id, source_asset_id, exact source filename/hash, output path/hash, region, preserved/changed details and status. Compute new hashes from files; leave null + not_computed if unavailable. No empty dummy image files. Missing originals belong in request_results with original_missing, not a fabricated file. READY-TO-PASTE COVER

assets.title: Boss and Caleb panel plans
assets.text:
HON DOLO — PROPOSED BOSS AND CALEB COVERAGE
Package GROK-HD-20261008. These are semantic scene beats, not new fixed song timecodes. Keep the existing lyric master and shot_plan unchanged. Stills first; Flow is a later motion candidate, not a promise of preserved details.

SHARED SHOT RULES
16:9 compositions, one clear beat per panel, readable facial scale and distinct silhouettes. Maintain one meeting layout and eyeline axis across coverage; record camera side instead of accidentally mirroring the tattoos. Show only supported body details. Natural hands separated from faces/props. No on-image text, spoken dialogue or lip-sync. Use exact accepted return image IDs for later Flow attachments. A wide shot does not automatically supply a reliable face reference.

BOSS SLOT
Boss discovery now compares hippo, gecko-frog and original slug directions across five rounds of ten. No winner is selected. All boss interaction panels below are HOLD proposals until selection; the former Jabba-only assumption is superseded. See boss_discovery_20261008.txt.

SC-BOSS-001 / PINSTRIPE MEETING — FIVE PANEL PROPOSALS
Base wardrobe: REF-pinstripe-source.jpg, corrected through REV-HD-003. Current details: HD-DESIGN-01. The office/penthouse luxury mood can meet the selected boss setting, but a set redesign is a proposal, not a source-preservation claim.

BOSS-P01 — The appointment [HOLD UNTIL BOSS SELECTED]
Medium-wide two-shot: suited Hon Dolo image-left, the selected boss image-right on a low dais or coherent seated position, both readable and turned toward each other across a small open negotiation space. Dolo has confident posture; the power imbalance comes from blocking, not threats. Avoid adding extra named cast. Keep hands resting neutrally. Return this master first; selected identity must match its accepted reference.
Flow candidate after acceptance: slow push-in with a small Dolo head turn; no dialogue.

BOSS-P02 — Terms [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Medium two-shot on the same axis. Dolo makes one small open-palmed business gesture; boss listens. Keep both faces in view, stable furniture and the pinstripe silhouette. No new money exchange or signed document invented as a story fact.
Motion candidate: gesture settles, small glance to boss.

BOSS-P03 — The calculation [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Dolo-dominant medium shot with boss recognizable deeper in frame. A restrained smug smile communicates "strictly business" while his posture remains alert. Grill and neck lettering stay readable. No exaggerated mouth performance.
Motion candidate: brief glance down then back up.

BOSS-P04 — Boss reaction [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Boss-dominant view, Dolo in a clear shoulder/three-quarter foreground relationship. Preserve the meeting axis. Use only body portions supported by the chosen boss master; no invented unseen limbs or face redesign.
Motion candidate: small reaction with Dolo almost still.

BOSS-P05 — Business concluded [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Return to a wider two-shot. Dolo angles toward the exit but keeps enough face visible for identity; boss stays in place. This is an ambiguous end to the meeting, not proof of paid debt or a changed plot outcome. Do not expose an invented back tattoo.
Motion candidate: one small turn/step after proof, no complex walk choreography.

SC-CAL-001 / WESTERN SALOON — FOUR PANEL PROPOSALS
Base: HD-SALOON-01-chest-up.jpg is the user's chosen outfit/bar alpha. Use REF-saloon-source.jpg for environment and the corrected REV-HD-004 prop/context. Caleb K is a distinct middle-aged white male lawyer, no supplied real-person likeness. First return one neutral three-quarter or frontal portrait, CALEB-K_REF_v001.png, with clear face and ordinary restrained lawyer wardrobe; creative details are allowed as proposals; any new tattoo needs its same-delivery four-option design sheet, and no new feature is an automatic lock.

The remembered cue "That's my dog dipped in flavor, Caleb K" is approximate and is not in the verified Strictly Business lyric master. Keep its song alignment pending. Do not turn it into spoken dialogue or add it to the song.

CAL-P01 — My lawyer at the bar [INITIAL TWO-PERSON PROOF]
Medium two-shot in the warm wooden saloon, Hon Dolo in his fringe look and Caleb seated or standing beside him at the bar. Familiar amused recognition, both faces clearly readable, hands resting separately. Caleb looks like his neutral reference. No drinks or paperwork need to become required story props. Nonviolent, no drawn weapon; if the hip is visible, use the corrected holster.
Flow candidate after acceptance: friendly nod, a tiny shoulder turn and subtle camera drift. No lip-sync.

CAL-P02 — Recognition [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Same side of the bar and same eyeline axis. Dolo gestures toward Caleb with one small open hand, no face-touching or tangled handshake. Caleb gives a restrained amused response. Keep both expressions legible.

CAL-P03 — Caleb's reaction [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Caleb-dominant medium with Dolo visibly present at the edge/foreground. A knowing lawyer's look is enough; no invented spoken line, legal document text or new criminal plot.

CAL-P04 — Shared laugh / settled beat [PROPOSED, WAIT]
Balanced two-shot, a brief relaxed laugh or smile, then settled posture. Keep mouth movement modest for a future visual-only clip. Same clothes, hands, jewelry, prop side and bar geography as the accepted master.

REVIEW BEFORE EXPANSION
Check each face against its assigned identity reference, then current eye/know/blaster/grill and visible piercings, then outfit fabric, prop attachment, body-side labels, scale and eyelines. A selected scene alpha is not approval of every tattoo visible on it. Return mismatches with source/output IDs. Do not request full 360 sets for every look; add only the particular three-quarter view that a later shot demonstrably needs.
