Current scoring/generation must not be interrupted.",
  "correlation": "REFERENCE-MAP-TWO-AXIS-VALIDATION-20261013",
  "kind": "authorized_engineering_handoff_with_proposed_inventory_not_new_canon",
  "plan": "Ziggy now authorizes bounded engineering implementation, not merely a UI proposal. CFA Nova owns application and serialized publication at its natural checkpoint after current scoring/generation; this handoff does not compete with its browser/execution controller.\n\nImplement two independent validation indicators beside CHARACTER likeness stars and SCENE craft stars. Preserve the historical star meanings: character likeness and scene craft, independently 1–5 or unrated; any future desirability wording needs a dated distinction. Five stars do not establish validation. Validation is an evidence result from actual image comparison against a nominated scoped reference and explicit criteria, not a synonym for stars, design stage or Production approval. Preserve all manual reviews, provider history and human acceptance, including seven Production mouth details and previous review sets. Never auto-tick legacy assets.\n\nInspect the existing dropdown/serialization/export/import paths before any transition. The current normalizedReview field whitelist makes silently adding evidence into old review objects unsafe. Prefer an additive versioned validation sidecar with preserved assessment history and a separately reviewed reference-family map. Keep old 'verification' stage records readable as legacy manual design stages; do not convert them into AI passes. Any eventual dropdown transition must be reversible and tested against a pre-change snapshot. Do not remove values or rewrite old reviews destructively.\n\nEach axis needs status not_checked / pass / fail / uncertain and independent applicability (required / optional / not_applicable), reference asset ID, SHA-256 and explicit version or immutable snapshot, comparison scope, criteria/tolerance version, actual image IDs/hashes seen, reviewer/model/surface/time, per-criterion observations and outcomes, evidence/uncertainty and source provenance. N/A is not pass. A missing/unscoped reference, inaccessible image or unobservable required feature cannot produce a pass; offscreen required features remain unresolved. Character-detail passes cover only visible scoped details, never the whole actor or scene. A changed reference/hash/criteria version requires rechecking; retain prior evidence and display that it is stale.\n\nCharacter checks are stricter on identity, anatomy/build, required mouth state, tattoo spelling/placement and required jewelry. Apply documented natural placement/asymmetry/accessory tolerances rather than pixel matching or forced symmetry. Required jewelry must be present when required, while optional accessories and recorded pose/light/variation remain allowed. Scene checks use looser declared constraints: Hon's recurring Falcon cockpit/ship layout must remain consistent where actually locked; Lisan's wandering abstract/desert environments are OPEN unless a particular scene has an explicit lock. Do not invent a fixed Lisan home or universal scene standard. Mouth-only details normally have scene applicability N/A. A recurring pet selected by Ziggy should receive its own character reference with reasonable variation; no pet is selected by this handoff.\n\nOverall technical readiness is derived only from all required applicable checks passing and the existing ingredients/shoot-plan gates. Validation does not replace final human video judgment, launch approval, cost checks or accepted masters, and should not promise perfection. Missing/offscreen checks must remain visible. Separate future potential, needs repair, not ready to animate, and approved scoped reference use; preserve the original manual statuses.\n\nSeed the reference inventory from existing verified scoped selections rather than picking new gold. The attached snapshot mechanically carries all 18 existing BOM rows and current canonical review fields. Eight BOM rows contain an explicit selection; ten have null selection but are already Keep/Production for their specific roles, not rejected. Many families still need nomination/lineage reconciliation. Desired family record: family ID, nominated WORKING reference asset ID/hash/version/scope, explicit derivative links, required/optional visible criteria, allowed variation, acceptance evidence and unresolved decision/owner. A working nomination is distinct from Production acceptance. Actor acceptance does not approve scenes; crops govern only what is visible. '120 categories' was illustrative, not a measured count. Do not infer family lineage or acceptance from albums, filenames, covers or stars.\n\nNewcomer integration remains bounded and unassigned. Actual current I_AMs do not prove image viewing for Kimi, DeepSeek or Qwen. Kimi/DeepSeek desktop file access reports and Kimi's later browser/Linux 'image tools exist' report do not establish tested pixels; Qwen has text/courier evidence. Claude's statement 'DeepSeek cannot view images' is too strong: vision is untested. Before any visual backlog assignment, a separately authorized actual-session calibration should demonstrate image access and three checkable pixel-only facts, then compare known accepted/failure examples using these scoped references. Keep provisional AI ratings separate from Ziggy's ratings; no acceptance override. If no vision, use metadata/text QA. Honor frozen Phase 0; no reset or model activation. Claude's nine proposals are source-linked; its preferred first tasks are Kimi coverage inventory, DeepSeek repair/intake text reconciliation and Qwen draft coverage prompts, all still proposals. Lisan-only coverage and user review gates remain.\n\nRequired verification for implementation: lossless round-trip/preservation of all 176 current review records and favorites/history; retain legacy verification-stage values without AI passes; independent character/scene statuses; N/A details; missing reference/image/occluded required criterion; strict required jewelry versus allowed variation; reference/criteria-change invalidation; same-hash/version provenance; sidecar import/export and restart; old storage/backups; UI badges beside stars; rollback. Run existing relevant reference-scope, scene-craft/readiness, working-BOM and review-import regressions plus meaningful new sidecar tests. Use the owner-controlled existing browser for the final UI check and serialized catalog build; no competing rebuild.\n\nCFA Nova updates canonical production/reference methods, current/future onboarding/carepack wrappers and reviewer instructions through their established owner routes after implementing/verifying the schema. Claude reconciles creative/reference criteria and its own guidance; HaL receives this source-aware future-return guidance. Crosslink central methods instead of spawning conflicting copies; preserve author/writer attribution. Return changed files, measured preservation/test results, actual publication evidence and remaining bounded decisions. This engineering task authorizes code/docs/metadata organization only, not new image/video generation, purchases, uploads, unlimited retries, broad canon resets or activation. Existing alien-dog images should be located and shown; do not generate replacements or nominate a new pet automatically.\n",
